[contain:inline-size] isolate" data-page-title="Thinking in LangGraph" data-page-href="/oss/python/langgraph/thinking-in-langgraph" id="content"><span data-as="p">When you build an agent with LangGraph, you will first break it apart into discrete steps called <strong>nodes</strong>. Then, you will describe the different decisions and transitions from each of your nodes. Finally, you connect nodes together through a shared <strong>state</strong> that each node can read from and write to.</span>
<span data-as="p">In this walkthrough, we’ll guide you through the thought process of building a customer support email agent with LangGraph.</span>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="start-with-the-process-you-want-to-automate"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#start-with-the-process-you-want-to-automate" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Start with the process you want to automate</span></h2>

<span data-as="p">To implement an agent in LangGraph, you will usually follow the same five steps.</span>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="step-1:-map-out-your-workflow-as-discrete-steps"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#step-1:-map-out-your-workflow-as-discrete-steps" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Step 1: Map out your workflow as discrete steps</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">Start by identifying the distinct steps in your process. Each step will become a <strong>node</strong> (a function that does one specific thing). Then, sketch how these steps connect to each other.</span>
<!--$!--><template data-dgst="BAILOUT_TO_CLIENT_SIDE_RENDERING"></template><!--/$-->
<span data-as="p">The arrows in this diagram show possible paths, but the actual decision of which path to take happens inside each node.</span>
<span data-as="p">Now that we’ve identified the components in our workflow, let’s understand what each node needs to do:</span>
<ul>
<li><code>Read Email</code>: Extract and parse the email content</li>
<li><code>Classify Intent</code>: Use an LLM to categorize urgency and topic, then route to appropriate action</li>
<li><code>Doc Search</code>: Query your knowledge base for relevant information</li>
<li><code>Bug Track</code>: Create or update issue in tracking system</li>
<li><code>Draft Reply</code>: Generate an appropriate response</li>
<li><code>Human Review</code>: Escalate to human agent for approval or handling</li>
<li><code>Send Reply</code>: Dispatch the email response</li>
</ul>

2.62548C5.31288 2.38369 5.11599 2.18767 4.87534 2.18767Z"></path></svg></div><div class="text-sm prose dark:prose-invert min-w-0 w-full [&amp;_kbd]:bg-background-light dark:[&amp;_kbd]:bg-background-dark [&amp;_code]:!text-current [&amp;_kbd]:!text-current [&amp;_a]:!text-current [&amp;_a]:border-current text-green-800 dark:text-green-300" data-component-part="callout-content"><span data-as="p">Notice that some nodes make decisions about where to go next (<code>Classify Intent</code>, <code>Draft Reply</code>, <code>Human <span data-as="p">For each node in your graph, determine what type of operation it represents and what context it needs to work properly.</span>

<span data-as="p">When a step needs to understand, analyze, generate text, or make reasoning decisions:</span>
<div class="accordion-group [&amp;&gt;details]:border-0 [&amp;&gt;details]:rounded-none [&amp;&gt;details&gt;summary]:rounded-none [&amp;&gt;details]:mb-0 overflow-hidden mt-0 mb-3 rounded-xl prose prose-gray dark:prose-invert divide-y divide-inherit border dark:border-gray-800/50"><details class="accordion border-standard rounded-2xl mb-3 overflow-hidden bg-background-light dark:bg-codeblock cursor-default"><summary class="relative not-prose flex flex-row items-center content-center w-full cursor-pointer list-none [&amp;::-webkit-details-marker]:hidden py-4 px-5 space-x-2 hover:bg-gray-100 hover:dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-t-xl" aria-controls="classify-intent accordion children" aria-expanded="false" data-component-part="accordion-button"><div id="classify-intent" class="absolute -top-[8rem]"></div><div class="mr-0.5" data-component-part="accordion-caret-right"><svg class="h-3 w-3 transition bg-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-400 duration-75" style="-webkit-mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/solid/caret-right.svg);-webkit-mask-repeat:no-repeat;-webkit-mask-position:center;mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/solid/caret-right.svg);mask-repeat:no-repeat;mask-position:center"></svg></div><div class="leading-tight text-left w-full" contentEditable="false" data-component-part="accordion-title-container"><p class="m-0 font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-200" data-component-part="accordion-title">Classify intent</p></div></summary><div id="classify-intent accordion children" role="region" aria-labelledby="classify-intent" class="mt-2 mb-4 mx-6 prose prose-gray dark:prose-invert overflow-x-auto cursor-default" data-component-part="accordion-content"><ul>

<li>Dynamic context (from state): Email content, sender information</li>
<li>Desired outcome: Structured classification that determines routing</li>
</ul></div></details><details class="accordion border-standard rounded-2xl mb-3 overflow-hidden bg-background-light dark:bg-codeblock cursor-default"><summary class="relative not-prose flex flex-row items-center content-center w-full cursor-pointer list-none [&amp;::-webkit-details-marker]:hidden py-4 px-5 space-x-2 hover:bg-gray-100 hover:dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-t-xl" aria-controls="draft-reply accordion children" aria-expanded="false" data-component-part="accordion-button"><div id="draft-reply" class="absolute -top-[8rem]"></div><div class="mr-0.5" data-component-part="accordion-caret-right"><svg class="h-3 w-3 transition bg-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-400 duration-75" style="-webkit-mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/solid/caret-right.svg);-webkit-mask-repeat:no-repeat;-webkit-mask-position:center;mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/solid/caret-right.svg);mask-repeat:no-repeat;mask-position:center"></svg></div><div class="leading-tight text-left w-full" contentEditable="false" data-component-part="accordion-title-container"><p class="m-0 font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-200" data-component-part="accordion-title">Draft reply</p></div></summary><div id="draft-reply accordion children" role="region" aria-labelledby="draft-reply" class="mt-2 mb-4 mx-6 prose prose-gray dark:prose-invert overflow-x-auto cursor-default" data-component-part="accordion-content"><ul>
<li>Static context (prompt): Tone guidelines, company policies, response templates</li>
<li>Dynamic context (from state): Classification results, search results, customer history</li>
<li>Desired outcome: Professional email response ready for review</li>
</ul></div></details></div>

<span data-as="p">When a step needs to retrieve information from external sources:</span>

<div class="accordion-group [&amp;&gt;details]:border-0 [&amp;&gt;details]:rounded-none [&amp;&gt;details&gt;summary]:rounded-none [&amp;&gt;details]:mb-0 overflow-hidden mt-0 mb-3 rounded-xl prose prose-gray dark:prose-invert divide-y divide-inherit border dark:border-gray-800/50"><details class="accordion border-standard rounded-2xl mb-3 overflow-hidden bg-background-light dark:bg-codeblock cursor-default"><summary class="relative not-prose flex flex-row items-center content-center w-full cursor-pointer list-none [&amp;::-webkit-details-marker]:hidden py-4 px-5 space-x-2 hover:bg-gray-100 hover:dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-t-xl" aria-controls="send-reply accordion children" aria-expanded="false" data-component-part="accordion-button"><div id="send-reply" class="absolute -top-[8rem]"></div><div class="mr-0.5" data-component-part="accordion-caret-right"><svg class="h-3 w-3 transition bg-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-400 duration-75" style="-webkit-mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/solid/caret-right.svg);-webkit-mask-repeat:no-repeat;-webkit-mask-position:center;mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/solid/caret-right.svg);mask-repeat:no-repeat;mask-position:center"></svg></div><div class="leading-tight text-left w-full" contentEditable="false" data-component-part="accordion-title-container"><p class="m-0 font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-200" data-component-part="accordion-title">Send reply</p></div></summary><div id="send-reply accordion children" role="region" aria-labelledby="send-reply" class="mt-2 mb-4 mx-6 prose prose-gray dark:prose-invert overflow-x-auto cursor-default" data-component-part="accordion-content"><ul>

<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="user-input-steps"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#user-input-steps" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">User input steps</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">When a step needs human intervention:</span>
<div class="accordion-group [&amp;&gt;details]:border-0 [&amp;&gt;details]:rounded-none [&amp;&gt;details&gt;summary]:rounded-none [&amp;&gt;details]:mb-0 overflow-hidden mt-0 mb-3 rounded-xl prose prose-gray dark:prose-invert divide-y divide-inherit border dark:border-gray-800/50"><details class="accordion border-standard rounded-2xl mb-3 overflow-hidden bg-background-light dark:bg-codeblock cursor-default"><summary class="relative not-prose flex flex-row items-center content-center w-full cursor-pointer list-none [&amp;::-webkit-details-marker]:hidden py-4 px-5 space-x-2 hover:bg-gray-100 hover:dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-t-xl" aria-controls="human-review-node accordion children" aria-expanded="false" data-component-part="accordion-button"><div id="human-review-node" class="absolute -top-[8rem]"></div><div class="mr-0.5" data-component-part="accordion-caret-right"><svg class="h-3 w-3 transition bg-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-400 duration-75" style="-webkit-mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/solid/caret-right.svg);-webkit-mask-repeat:no-repeat;-webkit-mask-position:center;mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/solid/caret-right.svg);mask-repeat:no-repeat;mask-position:center"></svg></div><div class="leading-tight text-left w-full" contentEditable="false" data-component-part="accordion-title-container"><p class="m-0 font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-200" data-component-part="accordion-title">Human review node</p></div></summary><div id="human-review-node accordion children" role="region" aria-labelledby="human-review-node" class="mt-2 mb-4 mx-6 prose prose-gray dark:prose-invert overflow-x-auto cursor-default" data-component-part="accordion-content"><ul>
<li>Context for decision: Original email, draft response, urgency, classification</li>
<li>Expected input format: Approval boolean plus optional edited response</li>
<li>When triggered: High urgency, complex issues, or quality concerns</li>
</ul></div></details></div>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="step-3:-design-your-state"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#step-3:-design-your-state" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Step 3: Design your state</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">State is the shared <a class="link" href="/oss/python/concepts/memory">memory</a> accessible to all nodes in your agent. Think of it as the notebook your agent uses to keep track of everything it learns and decides as it works through the process.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="what-belongs-in-state"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#what-belongs-in-state" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">What belongs in state?</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Ask yourself these questions about each piece of data:</span>
<div class="card-group prose dark:prose-dark grid gap-x-4 sm:grid-cols-2"><div class="card block font-normal group relative my-2 ring-2 ring-transparent rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-background-dark border border-gray-950/10 dark:border-white/10 overflow-hidden w-full"><div class="px-6 py-5 relative" data-component-part="card-content-container"><div class="h-6 w-6 fill-gray-800 dark:fill-gray-100 text-gray-800 dark:text-gray-100" data-component-part="card-icon"><svg class="h-6 w-6 bg-primary dark:bg-primary-light !m-0 shrink-0" style="-webkit-mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/check.svg);-webkit-mask-repeat:no-repeat;-webkit-mask-position:center;mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/check.svg);mask-repeat:no-repeat;mask-position:center"></svg></div><div class="w-full"><h2 class="not-prose font-semibold text-base text-gray-800 dark:text-white mt-4" contentEditable="false" data-component-part="card-title">Include in state</h2><div class="prose mt-1 font-normal text-base leading-6 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400" data-component-part="card-content"><span data-as="p">Does it need to persist across steps? If yes, it goes in state.</span></div></div></div></div><div class="card block font-normal group relative my-2 ring-2 ring-transparent rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-background-dark border border-gray-950/10 dark:border-white/10 overflow-hidden w-full"><div class="px-6 py-5 relative" data-component-part="card-content-container"><div class="h-6 w-6 fill-gray-800 dark:fill-gray-100 text-gray-800 dark:text-gray-100" data-component-part="card-icon"><svg class="h-6 w-6 bg-primary dark:bg-primary-light !m-0 shrink-0" style="-webkit-mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/code.svg);-webkit-mask-repeat:no-repeat;-webkit-mask-position:center;mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/code.svg);mask-repeat:no-repeat;mask-position:center"></svg></div><div class="w-full"><h2 class="not-prose font-semibold text-base text-gray-800 dark:text-white mt-4" contentEditable="false" data-component-part="card-title">Don&#x27;t store</h2><div class="prose mt-1 font-normal text-base leading-6 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400" data-component-part="card-content"><span data-as="p">Can you derive it from other data? If yes, compute it when needed instead of storing it in state.</span></div></div></div></div></div>
<span data-as="p">For our email agent, we need to track:</span>
<ul>
<li>The original email and sender info (can’t reconstruct these later)</li>
<li>Classification results (needed by multiple later/downstream nodes)</li>
<li>Search results and customer data (expensive to re-fetch)</li>
<li>The draft response (needs to persist through review)</li>
<li>Execution metadata (for debugging and recovery)</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="keep-state-raw,-format-prompts-on-demand"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#keep-state-raw,-format-prompts-on-demand" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Keep state raw, format prompts on-demand</span></h3>
<div class="callout my-4 px-5 py-4 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl flex gap-3 border border-green-200 bg-green-50 dark:border-green-900 dark:bg-green-600/20 [&amp;_[data-component-part=&#x27;callout-icon&#x27;]]:mt-px" data-callout-type="tip"><div class="mt-0.5 w-4" data-component-part="callout-icon"><svg width="11" height="14" viewBox="0 0 11 14" fill="currentColor" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="text-green-800 dark:text-green-300 w-3.5 h-auto" aria-label="Tip"><path d="M3.12794 12.4232C3.12794 12.5954 3.1776 12.7634 3.27244 2.68767 4.37534C2.68767 4.61719 2.88336 4.81288 3.12521 4.81288C3.36705 4.81288 3.56274 4.61599 3.56274 4.37534C3.56274 3.6515 4.1515 3.06274 4.87534 3.06274C5.11719 3.06274 5.31288 2.86727 5.31288 2.62548C5.31288 2.38369 5.11599 2.18767 4.87534 2.18767Z"></path></svg></div><div class="text-sm prose dark:prose-invert min-w-0 w-full [&amp;_kbd]:bg-background-light dark:[&amp;_kbd]:bg-background-dark [&amp;_code]:!text-current [&amp;_kbd]:!text-current [&amp;_a]:!text-current [&amp;_a]:border-current text-green-800 dark:text-green-300" data-component-part="callout-content"><span data-as="p">A key principle: your state should store raw data, not formatted text. Format prompts inside nodes when you need them.</span></div></div>
<span data-as="p">This separation means:</span>
<ul>
<li>Different nodes can format the same data differently for their needs</li>
<li>You can change prompt templates without modifying your state schema</li>
<li>Debugging is clearer – you see exactly what data each node received</li>
<li>Your agent can evolve without breaking existing state</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">Let’s define our state:</span>

<span data-as="p">Notice that the state contains only raw data – no prompt templates, no formatted strings, no instructions. The classification output is stored as a single dictionary, straight from the LLM.</span>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="step-4:-build-your-nodes"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#step-4:-build-your-nodes" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Step 4: Build your nodes</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">Now we implement each step as a function. A node in LangGraph is just a Python function that takes the current state and returns updates to it.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="handle-errors-appropriately"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#handle-errors-appropriately" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Handle errors appropriately</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Different errors need different handling strategies:</span>
<div data-table-wrapper="true" class="[--page-padding:20px] overflow-x-auto flex w-[calc(100%+(var(--page-padding)*2))] my-[1em] py-[1em] -mx-[var(--page-padding)] max-w-none [contain:inline-size]"><div class="px-[var(--page-padding)] grow max-w-none table"><table class="m-0 min-w-full w-full max-w-none table [&amp;_td]:min-w-[150px] [&amp;_th]:text-left [&amp;_td[data-numeric]]:tabular-nums"><thead><tr><th>Error Type</th><th>Who Fixes It</th><th>Strategy</th><th>When to Use</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Transient errors (network issues, rate limits)</td><td>System (automatic)</td><td>Retry policy</td><td>Temporary failures that usually resolve on retry</td></tr><tr><td>LLM-recoverable errors (tool failures, parsing issues)</td><td>LLM</td><td>Store error in state and loop back</td><td>LLM can see the error and adjust its approach</td></tr><tr><td>User-fixable errors (missing information, unclear instructions)</td><td>Human</td><td>Pause with <code>interrupt()</code></td><td>Need user input to proceed</td></tr><tr><td>Unexpected errors</td><td>Developer</td><td>Let them bubble up</td><td>Unknown issues that need debugging</td></tr></tbody></table></div></div>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">def</span><span style="color:#8250DF;--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA"> classify_intent</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">(</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">state</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: EmailAgentState) -&gt; Command[Literal[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;search_documentation&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;human_review&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;draft_response&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;bug_tracking&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">]]:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">    &quot;&quot;&quot;Use LLM to classify email intent and urgency, then route accordingly&quot;&quot;&quot;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955">    # Create structured LLM that returns EmailClassification dict</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    structured_llm </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> llm.with_structured_output(EmailClassification)</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">    Analyze this customer email and classify it:</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">    Email: </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">{</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">state[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&#x27;email_content&#x27;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">]</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">    From: </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">{</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">state[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&#x27;sender_email&#x27;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">]</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">    Provide classification including intent, urgency, topic, and summary.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">    &quot;&quot;&quot;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955">    # Get structured response directly as dict</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    classification </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> structured_llm.invoke(classification_prompt)</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955">    # Determine next node based on classification</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">    elif</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> classification[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&#x27;intent&#x27;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">] </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">==</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178"> &#x27;bug&#x27;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">:</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">    else</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">:</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    )</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">        &quot;draft_response&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: state.get(</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&#x27;draft_response&#x27;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">,</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&#x27;&#x27;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">),</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">        &quot;urgency&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: classification.get(</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&#x27;urgency&#x27;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">),</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">        &quot;intent&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: classification.get(</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&#x27;intent&#x27;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">),</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">        &quot;action&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;Please review and approve/edit this response&quot;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    })</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955">    # Now process the human&#x27;s decision</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">    if</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> human_decision.get(</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;approved&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">):</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">        return</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> Command(</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#953800;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">            update</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">{</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;draft_response&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: human_decision.get(</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;edited_response&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, state.get(</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&#x27;draft_response&#x27;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">,</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&#x27;&#x27;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">))},</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#953800;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">            goto</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;send_reply&quot;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">        )</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">    else</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955">        # Rejection means human will handle directly</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">        return</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> Command(</span><span style="color:#953800;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">update</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">{}, </span><span style="color:#953800;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">goto</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">END</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">def</span><span style="color:#8250DF;--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA"> send_reply</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">(</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">state</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: EmailAgentState) -&gt; </span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0">dict</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">    &quot;&quot;&quot;Send the email response&quot;&quot;&quot;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955">    # Integrate with email service</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA">    print</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">(</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">f</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;Sending reply: </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">{</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">state[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&#x27;draft_response&#x27;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">][:</span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#B5CEA8">100</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">]</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">}</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">...&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>

<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="step-5:-wire-it-together"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#step-5:-wire-it-together" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Step 5: Wire it together</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">Now we connect our nodes into a working graph. Since our nodes handle their own routing decisions, we only need a few essential edges.</span>
<span data-as="p">To enable <a class="link" href="/oss/python/langgraph/interrupts">human-in-the-loop</a> with <code>interrupt()</code>, we need to compile with a <a class="link" href="/oss/python/langgraph/persistence">checkpointer</a> to save state between runs:</span>

<span data-as="p">The graph structure is minimal because routing happens inside nodes through <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/types/#langgraph.types.Command" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>Command</code></a> objects. Each node declares where it can go using type hints like <code>Command[Literal[&quot;node1&quot;, &quot;node2&quot;]]</code>, making the flow explicit and traceable.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="try-out-your-agent"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#try-out-your-agent" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Try out your agent</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Let’s run our agent with an urgent billing issue that needs human review:</span>

</code></pre></div></div><div data-fade-overlay="true" aria-hidden="true" style="--fade-color-light:#ffffff;--fade-color-dark:#0B0C0E"></div></div></div></details>
<span data-as="p">The graph pauses when it hits <code>interrupt()</code>, saves everything to the checkpointer, and waits. It can resume days later, picking up exactly where it left off. The <code>thread_id</code> ensures all state for this conversation is preserved together.</span>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="summary-and-next-steps"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#summary-and-next-steps" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Summary and next steps</span></h2>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="key-insights"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#key-insights" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Key Insights</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Building this email agent has shown us the LangGraph way of thinking:</span>
<div class="card-group prose dark:prose-dark grid gap-x-4 sm:grid-cols-2"><a class="card block font-normal group relative my-2 ring-2 ring-transparent rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-background-dark border border-gray-950/10 dark:border-white/10 overflow-hidden w-full cursor-pointer hover:!border-primary dark:hover:!border-primary-light" href="#step-1-map-out-your-workflow-as-discrete-steps"><div class="px-6 py-5 relative" data-component-part="card-content-container"><div id="card-link-arrow-icon" class="absolute text-gray-400 dark:text-gray-500 group-hover:text-primary dark:group-hover:text-primary-light top-5 right-5 hidden"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-arrow-up-right w-4 h-4"><path d="M7 7h10v10"></path><path d="M7 17 17 7"></path></svg></div><div class="h-6 w-6 fill-gray-800 dark:fill-gray-100 text-gray-800 dark:text-gray-100" data-component-part="card-icon"><svg class="h-6 w-6 bg-primary dark:bg-primary-light !m-0 shrink-0" style="-webkit-mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/sitemap.svg);-webkit-mask-repeat:no-repeat;-webkit-mask-position:center;mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/sitemap.svg);mask-repeat:no-repeat;mask-position:center"></svg></div><div class="w-full"><h2 class="not-prose font-semibold text-base text-gray-800 dark:text-white mt-4" contentEditable="false" data-component-part="card-title">Break into discrete steps</h2><div class="prose mt-1 font-normal text-base leading-6 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400" data-component-part="card-content"><span data-as="p">Each node does one thing well. This decomposition enables streaming progress updates, durable execution that can pause and resume, and clear debugging since you can inspect state between steps.</span></div></div></div></a><a class="card block font-normal group relative my-2 ring-2 ring-transparent rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-background-dark border border-gray-950/10 dark:border-white/10 overflow-hidden w-full cursor-pointer hover:!border-primary dark:hover:!border-primary-light" href="#step-3-design-your-state"><div class="px-6 py-5 relative" data-component-part="card-content-container"><div id="card-link-arrow-icon" class="absolute text-gray-400 dark:text-gray-500 group-hover:text-primary dark:group-hover:text-primary-light top-5 right-5 hidden"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-arrow-up-right w-4 h-4"><path d="M7 7h10v10"></path><path d="M7 17 17 7"></path></svg></div><div class="h-6 w-6 fill-gray-800 dark:fill-gray-100 text-gray-800 dark:text-gray-100" data-component-part="card-icon"><svg class="h-6 w-6 bg-primary dark:bg-primary-light !m-0 shrink-0" style="-webkit-mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/database.svg);-webkit-mask-repeat:no-repeat;-webkit-mask-position:center;mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/database.svg);mask-repeat:no-repeat;mask-position:center"></svg></div><div class="w-full"><h2 class="not-prose font-semibold text-base text-gray-800 dark:text-white mt-4" contentEditable="false" data-component-part="card-title">State is shared memory</h2><div class="prose mt-1 font-normal text-base leading-6 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400" data-component-part="card-content"><span data-as="p">Store raw data, not formatted text. This lets different nodes use the same information in different ways.</span></div></div></div></a><a class="card block font-normal group relative my-2 ring-2 ring-transparent rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-background-dark border border-gray-950/10 dark:border-white/10 overflow-hidden w-full cursor-pointer hover:!border-primary dark:hover:!border-primary-light" href="#step-4-build-your-nodes"><div class="px-6 py-5 relative" data-component-part="card-content-container"><div id="card-link-arrow-icon" class="absolute text-gray-400 dark:text-gray-500 group-hover:text-primary dark:group-hover:text-primary-light top-5 right-5 hidden"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-arrow-up-right w-4 h-4"><path d="M7 7h10v10"></path><path d="M7 17 17 7"></path></svg></div><div class="h-6 w-6 fill-gray-800 dark:fill-gray-100 text-gray-800 dark:text-gray-100" data-component-part="card-icon"><svg class="h-6 w-6 bg-primary dark:bg-primary-light !m-0 shrink-0" style="-webkit-mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/code.svg);-webkit-mask-repeat:no-repeat;-webkit-mask-position:center;mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/code.svg);mask-repeat:no-repeat;mask-position:center"></svg></div><div class="w-full"><h2 class="not-prose font-semibold text-base text-gray-800 dark:text-white mt-4" contentEditable="false" data-component-part="card-title">Nodes are functions</h2><div class="prose mt-1 font-normal text-base leading-6 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400" data-component-part="card-content"><span data-as="p">They take state, do work, and return updates. When they need to make routing decisions, they specify both the state updates and the next destination.</span></div></div></div></a><a class="card block font-normal group relative my-2 ring-2 ring-transparent rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-background-dark border border-gray-950/10 dark:border-white/10 overflow-hidden w-full cursor-pointer hover:!border-primary dark:hover:!border-primary-light" href="#handle-errors-appropriately"><div class="px-6 py-5 relative" data-component-part="card-content-container"><div id="card-link-arrow-icon" class="absolute indefinitely, saves all state, and resumes exactly where it left off when you provide input. This keeps control flow explicit and traceable - you can always understand what your agent will do next by looking at the current node.</span></div></div></div></a></div>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="advanced-considerations"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#advanced-considerations" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Advanced considerations</span></h3>

-top-[8rem]"></div><div class="mr-0.5" data-component-part="accordion-caret-right"><svg class="h-3 w-3 transition bg-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-400 duration-75" class="h-4 w-4 fill-gray-800 dark:fill-gray-100 text-gray-800 dark:text-gray-100" data-component-part="accordion-icon"><svg class="w-4 h-4 bg-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-100" style="-webkit-mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/sliders.svg);-webkit-mask-repeat:no-repeat;-webkit-mask-position:center;mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/sliders.svg);mask-repeat:no-repeat;mask-position:center"></svg></div><div data-component-part="accordion-title">Node granularity trade-offs</p></div></summary><div id="node-granularity-trade-offs accordion children" role="region" aria-labelledby="node-granularity-trade-offs" class="mt-2 mb-4 mx-6 prose prose-gray dark:prose-invert overflow-x-auto cursor-default" data-component-part="accordion-content"><div class="callout my-4 px-5 py-4 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl flex gap-3 border border-neutral-200 bg-neutral-50 dark:border-neutral-700 dark:bg-white/10" data-callout-type="info"><div class="mt-0.5 w-4" data-component-part="callout-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="flex-none size-5 text-neutral-800 dark:text-neutral-300" aria-label="Info"><path d="M8 0C3.58125 0 0 3.58125 0 8C0 12.4187 3.58125 16 8 16C12.4187 16 16 12.4187 16 8C16 3.58125 12.4187 0 8 0ZM8 14.5C4.41563 14.5 1.5 11.5841 1.5 8C1.5 4.41594 4.41563 1.5 8 1.5C11.5844 1.5 14.5 4.41594 14.5 8C14.5 11.5841 11.5844 14.5 8 14.5ZM9.25 10.5H8.75V7.75C8.75 7.3375 8.41563 7 8 7H7C6.5875 7 6.25 7.3375 6.25 7.75C6.25 8.1625 6.5875 8.5 7 8.5H7.25V10.5H6.75C6.3375 10.5 6 10.8375 6 11.25C6 11.6625 6.3375 12 6.75 12H9.25C9.66406 12 10 11.6641 10 11.25C10 10.8359 9.66563 10.5 9.25 10.5ZM8 6C8.55219 6 9 5.55219 9 5C9 4.44781 8.55219 4 8 4C7.44781 4 7 4.44687 7 5C7 5.55313 7.44687 6 8 6Z"></path></svg></div><div class="text-sm prose dark:prose-invert min-w-0 w-full [&amp;_kbd]:bg-background-light dark:[&amp;_kbd]:bg-background-dark [&amp;_code]:!text-current [&amp;_kbd]:!text-current [&amp;_a]:!text-current [&amp;_a]:border-current text-neutral-800 dark:text-neutral-300" data-component-part="callout-content"><span data-as="p">This section explores the trade-offs in node granularity design. Most applications can skip this and use the patterns shown above.</span></div></div><span data-as="p">You might wonder: why not combine <code>Read Email</code> and <code>Classify Intent</code> into one node?</span><span data-as="p">Or why separate Doc Search from Draft Reply?</span><span data-as="p">The answer involves trade-offs between resilience and observability.</span><span data-as="p"><strong>The resilience consideration:</strong> LangGraph’s <a class="link" href="/oss/python/langgraph/durable-execution">durable execution</a> creates checkpoints at node boundaries. When a workflow resumes after an interruption or failure, it starts from the beginning of the node where execution stopped. Smaller nodes mean more frequent checkpoints, which means less work to repeat if something goes wrong. If you combine multiple operations into one large node, a failure near the end means re-executing everything from the start of that node.</span><span data-as="p">Why we chose this breakdown for the email agent:</span><ul>
<li>
<span data-as="p"><strong>Isolation of external services:</strong> Doc Search and Bug Track are separate nodes because they call external APIs. If the search service is slow or fails, we want to isolate that from the LLM calls. We can add retry policies to these specific nodes without affecting others.</span>
</li>
<li>
<span data-as="p"><strong>Intermediate visibility:</strong> Having <code>Classify Intent</code> as its own node lets us inspect what the LLM decided before taking action. This is valuable for debugging and monitoring—you can see exactly when and why the agent routes to human review.</span>
</li>
<li>
<span data-as="p"><strong>Different failure modes:</strong> LLM calls, database lookups, and email sending have different retry strategies. Separate nodes let you configure these independently.</span>
</li>
<li>
<span data-as="p"><strong>Reusability and testing:</strong> Smaller nodes are easier to test in isolation and reuse in other workflows.</span>
</li>
</ul><span data-as="p">A different valid approach: You could combine <code>Read Email</code> and <code>Classify Intent</code> into a single node. You’d lose the ability to inspect the raw email before classification and would repeat both operations on any failure in that node. For most applications, the observability and debugging benefits of separate nodes are worth the trade-off.</span><span data-as="p">Application-level concerns: The caching discussion in Step 2 (whether to cache search results) is an application-level decision, not a LangGraph framework feature. You implement caching within your node functions based on your specific requirements—LangGraph doesn’t prescribe this.</span><span data-as="p">Performance considerations: More nodes doesn’t mean slower execution. LangGraph writes checkpoints in the background by default (<a class="link" href="/oss/python/langgraph/durable-execution#durability-modes">async durability mode</a>), so your graph continues running without waiting for checkpoints to complete. This means you get frequent checkpoints with minimal performance impact. You can adjust this behavior if needed—use <code>&quot;exit&quot;</code> mode to checkpoint only at completion, or <code>&quot;sync&quot;</code> mode to block execution until each checkpoint is written.</span></div></details>

<li>Agents are dynamic and define their own processes and tool usage.</li>

<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="llms-and-augmentations"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#llms-and-augmentations" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">LLMs and augmentations</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">Workflows and agentic systems are based on LLMs and the various augmentations you add to them. <a class="link" href="/oss/python/langchain/tools">Tool calling</a>, <a class="link" href="/oss/python/langchain/structured-output">structured outputs</a>, and <a class="link" href="/oss/python/langchain/short-term-memory">short term memory</a> are a few options for tailoring LLMs to your needs.</span>

<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="prompt-chaining"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#prompt-chaining" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Prompt chaining</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">Prompt chaining is when each LLM call processes the output of the previous call. It’s often used for performing well-defined tasks that can be broken down into smaller, verifiable steps. Some examples include:</span>
<ul>
<li>Translating documents into different languages</li>
<li>Verifying generated content for consistency</li>
</ul>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    msg </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> llm.invoke(</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">f</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;Write a short joke about </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">{</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">state[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&#x27;topic&#x27;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">]</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">}</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>

<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">def</span><span style="color:#8250DF;--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA"> check_punchline</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">(</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">state</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: State):</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">    &quot;&quot;&quot;Gate function to check if the joke has a punchline&quot;&quot;&quot;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955">    # Simple check - does the joke contain &quot;?&quot; or &quot;!&quot;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">    if</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178"> &quot;?&quot;</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6"> in</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> state[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;joke&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">] </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">or</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178"> &quot;!&quot;</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6"> in</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> state[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;joke&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">]:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">        return</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178"> &quot;Pass&quot;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">    return</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178"> &quot;Fail&quot;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">def</span><span style="color:#8250DF;--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA"> improve_joke</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">(</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">state</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: State):</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">    &quot;&quot;&quot;Second LLM call to improve the joke&quot;&quot;&quot;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    msg </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> llm.invoke(</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">f</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;Make this joke funnier by adding wordplay: </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">{</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">state[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&#x27;joke&#x27;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">]</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">}</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">def</span><span style="color:#8250DF;--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA"> polish_joke</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">(</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">state</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: State):</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Add nodes</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">workflow.add_node(</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;generate_joke&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, generate_joke)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">workflow.add_node(</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;improve_joke&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, improve_joke)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">workflow.add_node(</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;polish_joke&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, polish_joke)</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">workflow.add_edge(</span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">START</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;generate_joke&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">workflow.add_conditional_edges(</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">    &quot;generate_joke&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, check_punchline, {</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;Fail&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;improve_joke&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;Pass&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: </span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">END</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">workflow.add_edge(</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;improve_joke&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;polish_joke&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">workflow.add_edge(</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;polish_joke&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, </span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">END</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Compile</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">state </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> chain.invoke({</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;topic&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;cats&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">})</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA">print</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">(</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;Initial joke:&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA">print</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">(state[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;joke&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">])</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA">print</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">(</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D7BA7D">\n</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">--- --- ---</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D7BA7D">\n</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">if</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178"> &quot;improved_joke&quot;</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6"> in</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> state:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA">    print</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">(</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;Improved joke:&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA">    print</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">(state[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;improved_joke&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">])</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA">    print</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">(</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D7BA7D">\n</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">--- --- ---</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D7BA7D">\n</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA">    print</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">(</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;Final joke:&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA">    print</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">(state[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;final_joke&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">])</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">else</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">:</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA">    print</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">(state[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;joke&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">])</span></span>

<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="parallelization"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#parallelization" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Parallelization</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">With parallelization, LLMs work simultaneously on a task. This is either done by running multiple independent subtasks at the same time, or running the same task multiple times to check for different outputs. Parallelization is commonly used to:</span>
<ul>
<li>Split up subtasks and run them in parallel, which increases speed</li>
<li>Run tasks multiple times to check for different outputs, which increases confidence</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">Some examples include:</span>
<ul>
<li>Running one subtask that processes a document for keywords, and a second subtask to check for formatting errors</li>
<li>Running a task multiple times that scores a document for accuracy based on different criteria, like the number of citations, the number of sources used, and the quality of the sources</li>
</ul>

<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="routing"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#routing" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Routing</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">Routing workflows process inputs and then directs them to context-specific tasks. This allows you to define specialized flows for complex tasks. For example, a workflow built to answer product related questions might process the type of question first, and then route the request to specific processes for pricing, refunds, returns, etc.</span>
