<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    result </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> llm.invoke(state[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;input&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">])</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">    return</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> {</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;output&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: result.content}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">def</span><span style="color:#8250DF;--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA"> llm_call_3</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">(</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">state</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: State):</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">    &quot;&quot;&quot;Write a poem&quot;&quot;&quot;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    result </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> llm.invoke(state[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;input&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">])</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">    return</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> {</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;output&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: result.content}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">def</span><span style="color:#8250DF;--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA"> llm_call_router</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">(</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">state</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: State):</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">    &quot;&quot;&quot;Route the input to the appropriate node&quot;&quot;&quot;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955">    # Run the augmented LLM with structured output to serve as routing logic</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    decision </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> router.invoke(</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">        [</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">            SystemMessage(</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#953800;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">                content</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;Route the input to story, joke, or poem based on the user&#x27;s request.&quot;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">            ),</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">            HumanMessage(</span><span style="color:#953800;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">content</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">state[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;input&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">]),</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">        ]</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    )</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">    return</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> {</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;decision&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: decision.step}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Conditional edge function to route to the appropriate node</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">def</span><span style="color:#8250DF;--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA"> route_decision</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">(</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">state</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: State):</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955">    # Return the node name you want to visit next</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">    if</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> state[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;decision&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">] </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">==</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178"> &quot;story&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">        return</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178"> &quot;llm_call_1&quot;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">    elif</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> state[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;decision&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">] </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">==</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178"> &quot;joke&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">        return</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178"> &quot;llm_call_2&quot;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">    elif</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> state[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;decision&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">] </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">==</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178"> &quot;poem&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">        return</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178"> &quot;llm_call_3&quot;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Build workflow</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">router_builder </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> StateGraph(State)</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Add nodes</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">router_builder.add_node(</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;llm_call_1&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, llm_call_1)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">router_builder.add_node(</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;llm_call_2&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, llm_call_2)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">router_builder.add_node(</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;llm_call_3&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, llm_call_3)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">router_builder.add_node(</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;llm_call_router&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, llm_call_router)</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Add edges to connect nodes</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">router_builder.add_edge(</span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">START</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;llm_call_router&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">router_builder.add_conditional_edges(</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">    &quot;llm_call_router&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    route_decision,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    {  </span><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Name returned by route_decision : Name of next node to visit</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">        &quot;llm_call_1&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;llm_call_1&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">        &quot;llm_call_2&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;llm_call_2&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">        &quot;llm_call_3&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;llm_call_3&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">router_builder.add_edge(</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;llm_call_1&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, </span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">END</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">router_builder.add_edge(</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;llm_call_2&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, </span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">END</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">router_builder.add_edge(</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;llm_call_3&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, </span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">END</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Compile workflow</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">router_workflow </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> router_builder.compile()</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Show the workflow</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">display(Image(router_workflow.get_graph().draw_mermaid_png()))</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Invoke</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">state </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> router_workflow.invoke({</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;input&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;Write me a joke about cats&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">})</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA">print</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">(state[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;output&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">])</span></span>
</code></pre></div></div><div data-fade-overlay="true" aria-hidden="true" style="--fade-color-light:#ffffff;--fade-color-dark:#0B0C0E"></div></div><div data-state="inactive" data-orientation="horizontal" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="radix-_R_1rappbsnmkpt5qbsnpfdb_-trigger-1" hidden="" id="radix-_R_1rappbsnmkpt5qbsnpfdb_-content-1" tabindex="-1" class="w-full min-w-full max-w-full h-full max-h-full relative"></div></div></div>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="orchestrator-worker"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#orchestrator-worker" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Orchestrator-worker</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">In an orchestrator-worker configuration, the orchestrator:</span>
<ul>
<li>Breaks down tasks into subtasks</li>
<li>Delegates subtasks to workers</li>
<li>Synthesizes worker outputs into a final result</li>
</ul>
<span aria-owns="rmiz-modal-" data-rmiz=""><span data-rmiz-content="not-found" style="visibility:visible"><picture class="contents"><img data-path="oss/images/worker.png" src="https://mintcdn.com/langchain-5e9cc07a/ybiAaBfoBvFquMDz/oss/images/worker.png?fit=max&amp;auto=format&amp;n=ybiAaBfoBvFquMDz&amp;q=85&amp;s=2e423c67cd4f12e049cea9c169ff0676" alt="worker.png" class="object-contain" width="1486" height="548" decoding="async" sizes="(max-width: 1024px) 100vw, 704px" srcSet="https://mintcdn.com/langchain-5e9cc07a/ybiAaBfoBvFquMDz/oss/images/worker.png?w=280&amp;fit=max&amp;auto=format&amp;n=ybiAaBfoBvFquMDz&amp;q=85&amp;s=037222991ea08f889306be035c4730b6 280w, https://mintcdn.com/langchain-5e9cc07a/ybiAaBfoBvFquMDz/oss/images/worker.png?w=560&amp;fit=max&amp;auto=format&amp;n=ybiAaBfoBvFquMDz&amp;q=85&amp;s=081f3ff05cc1fe50770c864d74084b5b 560w, https://mintcdn.com/langchain-5e9cc07a/ybiAaBfoBvFquMDz/oss/images/worker.png?w=840&amp;fit=max&amp;auto=format&amp;n=ybiAaBfoBvFquMDz&amp;q=85&amp;s=0ef6c1b9ceb5159030aa34d0f05f1ada 840w, https://mintcdn.com/langchain-5e9cc07a/ybiAaBfoBvFquMDz/oss/images/worker.png?w=1100&amp;fit=max&amp;auto=format&amp;n=ybiAaBfoBvFquMDz&amp;q=85&amp;s=92ec7353a89ae96e221a5a8f65c88adf 1100w, https://mintcdn.com/langchain-5e9cc07a/ybiAaBfoBvFquMDz/oss/images/worker.png?w=1650&amp;fit=max&amp;auto=format&amp;n=ybiAaBfoBvFquMDz&amp;q=85&amp;s=71b201dd99fa234ebfb918915aac3295 1650w, https://mintcdn.com/langchain-5e9cc07a/ybiAaBfoBvFquMDz/oss/images/worker.png?w=2500&amp;fit=max&amp;auto=format&amp;n=ybiAaBfoBvFquMDz&amp;q=85&amp;s=4f7b6e2064db575027932394a3658fbd 2500w" data-optimize="true" style="aspect-ratio:1486 / 548"/></picture></span></span>
<span data-as="p">Orchestrator-worker workflows provide more flexibility and are often used when subtasks cannot be predefined the way they can with <a href="#parallelization" class="link">parallelization</a>. This is common with workflows that write code or need to update content across multiple files. For example, a workflow that needs to update installation instructions for multiple Python libraries across an unknown number of documents might use this pattern.</span>

<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="creating-workers-in-langgraph"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#creating-workers-in-langgraph" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Creating workers in LangGraph</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Orchestrator-worker workflows are common and LangGraph has built-in support for them. The <code>Send</code> API lets you dynamically create worker nodes and send them specific inputs. Each worker has its own state, and all worker outputs are written to a shared state key that is accessible to the orchestrator graph. This gives the orchestrator access to all worker output and allows it to synthesize them into a final output. The example below iterates over a list of sections and uses the <code>Send</code> API to send a section to each worker.</span>

14.25V7.25C16.25 6.14543 15.3546 5.25 14.25 5.25Z" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path><path d="M2.80103 11.998L1.77203 5.07397C1.61003 <span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Graph state</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">def</span><span style="color:#8250DF;--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA"> llm_call</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">(</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">state</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: WorkerState):</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">def</span><span style="color:#8250DF;--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA"> synthesizer</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">(</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">state</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: State):</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">    &quot;&quot;&quot;Synthesize full report from sections&quot;&quot;&quot;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955">    # List of completed sections</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    completed_sections </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> state[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;completed_sections&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">]</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955">    # Format completed section to str to use as context for final sections</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    completed_report_sections </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178"> &quot;</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D7BA7D">\n\n</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">---</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D7BA7D">\n\n</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">.join(completed_sections)</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">    return</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> {</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;final_report&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: completed_report_sections}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Conditional edge function to create llm_call workers that each write a section of the report</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">def</span><span style="color:#8250DF;--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA"> assign_workers</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">(</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">state</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: State):</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">    &quot;&quot;&quot;Assign a worker to each section in the plan&quot;&quot;&quot;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955">    # Kick off section writing in parallel via Send() API</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">    return</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> [Send(</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;llm_call&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, {</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;section&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: s}) </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">for</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> s </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">in</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> state[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;sections&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">]]</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Build workflow</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">orchestrator_worker_builder </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> StateGraph(State)</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Add the nodes</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">orchestrator_worker_builder.add_node(</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;orchestrator&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, orchestrator)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">orchestrator_worker_builder.add_node(</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;llm_call&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, llm_call)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">orchestrator_worker_builder.add_node(</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;synthesizer&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, synthesizer)</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Add edges to connect nodes</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">orchestrator_worker_builder.add_edge(</span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">START</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;orchestrator&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">orchestrator_worker_builder.add_conditional_edges(</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">    &quot;orchestrator&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, assign_workers, [</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;llm_call&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">]</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">orchestrator_worker_builder.add_edge(</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;llm_call&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;synthesizer&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">orchestrator_worker_builder.add_edge(</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;synthesizer&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, </span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">END</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Compile the workflow</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">orchestrator_worker </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> orchestrator_worker_builder.compile()</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Show the workflow</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">display(Image(orchestrator_worker.get_graph().draw_mermaid_png()))</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Invoke</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">state </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> orchestrator_worker.invoke({</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;topic&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;Create a report on LLM scaling laws&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">})</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">from</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> IPython.display </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">import</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> Markdown</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">Markdown(state[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;final_report&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">])</span></span>
</code></pre></div></div><div data-fade-overlay="true" aria-hidden="true" style="--fade-color-light:#ffffff;--fade-color-dark:#0B0C0E"></div></div>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="evaluator-optimizer"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#evaluator-optimizer" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Evaluator-optimizer</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">In evaluator-optimizer workflows, one LLM call creates a response and the other evaluates that response. If the evaluator or a <a class="link" href="/oss/python/langgraph/interrupts">human-in-the-loop</a> determines the response needs refinement, feedback is provided and the response is recreated. This loop continues until an acceptable response is generated.</span>
<span data-as="p">Evaluator-optimizer workflows are commonly used when there’s particular success criteria for a task, but iteration is required to meet that criteria. For example, there’s not always a perfect match when translating text between two languages. It might take a few iterations to generate a translation with the same meaning across the two languages.</span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">class</span><span style="color:#953800;--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0"> State</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">(</span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0">TypedDict</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">):</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    joke: </span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0">str</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    topic: </span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0">str</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    feedback: </span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0">str</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    funny_or_not: </span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0">str</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Schema for structured output to use in evaluation</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">class</span><span style="color:#953800;--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0"> Feedback</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">(</span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0">BaseModel</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">):</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    grade: Literal[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;funny&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;not funny&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">] </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> Field(</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#953800;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">        description</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;Decide if the joke is funny or not.&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    )</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    feedback: </span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0">str</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> =</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> Field(</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#953800;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">        description</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;If the joke is not funny, provide feedback on how to improve it.&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    )</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Augment the LLM with schema for structured output</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">evaluator </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> llm.with_structured_output(Feedback)</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Nodes</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">def</span><span style="color:#8250DF;--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA"> llm_call_generator</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">(</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">state</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: State):</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">    &quot;&quot;&quot;LLM generates a joke&quot;&quot;&quot;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">    if</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> state.get(</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;feedback&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">):</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">        msg </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> llm.invoke(</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">            f</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;Write a joke about </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">{</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">state[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&#x27;topic&#x27;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">]</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">}</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178"> but take into account the feedback: </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">{</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">state[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&#x27;feedback&#x27;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">]</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">}</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">        )</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">    else</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">        msg </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> llm.invoke(</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">f</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;Write a joke about </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">{</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">state[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&#x27;topic&#x27;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">]</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">}</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">    return</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> {</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;joke&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: msg.content}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">def</span><span style="color:#8250DF;--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA"> llm_call_evaluator</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">(</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">state</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: State):</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">    &quot;&quot;&quot;LLM evaluates the joke&quot;&quot;&quot;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    grade </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> evaluator.invoke(</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">f</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;Grade the joke </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">{</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">state[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&#x27;joke&#x27;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">]</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">}</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">    return</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> {</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;funny_or_not&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: grade.grade, </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;feedback&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: grade.feedback}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Conditional edge function to route back to joke generator or end based upon feedback from the evaluator</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">def</span><span style="color:#8250DF;--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA"> route_joke</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">(</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">state</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: State):</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">    &quot;&quot;&quot;Route back to joke generator or end based upon feedback from the evaluator&quot;&quot;&quot;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">    if</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> state[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;funny_or_not&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">] </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">==</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178"> &quot;funny&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">        return</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178"> &quot;Accepted&quot;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">    elif</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> state[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;funny_or_not&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">] </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">==</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178"> &quot;not funny&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">        return</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178"> &quot;Rejected + Feedback&quot;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Build workflow</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">optimizer_builder </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> StateGraph(State)</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Add the nodes</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">optimizer_builder.add_node(</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;llm_call_generator&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, llm_call_generator)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">optimizer_builder.add_node(</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;llm_call_evaluator&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, llm_call_evaluator)</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Add edges to connect nodes</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">optimizer_builder.add_edge(</span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">START</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;llm_call_generator&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">optimizer_builder.add_edge(</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;llm_call_generator&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;llm_call_evaluator&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">optimizer_builder.add_conditional_edges(</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">    &quot;llm_call_evaluator&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    route_joke,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    {  </span><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Name returned by route_joke : Name of next node to visit</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">        &quot;Accepted&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: </span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">END</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">        &quot;Rejected + Feedback&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;llm_call_generator&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Compile the workflow</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">optimizer_workflow </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> optimizer_builder.compile()</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Show the workflow</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">display(Image(optimizer_workflow.get_graph().draw_mermaid_png()))</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Invoke</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">state </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> optimizer_workflow.invoke({</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;topic&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;Cats&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">})</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA">print</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">(state[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;joke&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">])</span></span>
</code></pre></div></div><div data-fade-overlay="true" aria-hidden="true" style="--fade-color-light:#ffffff;--fade-color-dark:#0B0C0E"></div></div><div data-state="inactive" data-orientation="horizontal" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="radix-_R_2nappbsnmkpt5qbsnpfdb_-trigger-1" hidden="" id="radix-_R_2nappbsnmkpt5qbsnpfdb_-content-1" tabindex="-1" class="w-full min-w-full max-w-full h-full max-h-full relative"></div></div></div>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="agents"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#agents" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Agents</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">Agents are typically implemented as an LLM performing actions using <a class="link" href="/oss/python/langchain/tools">tools</a>. They operate in continuous feedback loops, and are used in situations where problems and solutions are unpredictable. Agents have more autonomy than workflows, and can make decisions about the tools they use and how to solve problems. You can still define the available toolset and guidelines for how agents behave.</span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Conditional edge function to route to the tool node or end based upon whether the LLM made a tool call</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">def</span><span style="color:#8250DF;--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA"> should_continue</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">(</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">state</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: MessagesState) -&gt; Literal[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;tool_node&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, </span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">END</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">]:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">    &quot;&quot;&quot;Decide if we should continue the loop or stop based upon whether the LLM made a tool call&quot;&quot;&quot;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    messages </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> state[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;messages&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">]</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    last_message </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> messages[</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">-</span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#B5CEA8">1</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">]</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955">    # If the LLM makes a tool call, then perform an action</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">    if</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> last_message.tool_calls:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">        return</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178"> &quot;tool_node&quot;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955">    # Otherwise, we stop (reply to the user)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">    return</span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> END</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Build workflow</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">agent_builder </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> StateGraph(MessagesState)</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Add nodes</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">agent_builder.add_node(</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;llm_call&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, llm_call)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">agent_builder.add_node(</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;tool_node&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, tool_node)</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Add edges to connect nodes</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">agent_builder.add_edge(</span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">START</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;llm_call&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">agent_builder.add_conditional_edges(</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">    &quot;llm_call&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    should_continue,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    [</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;tool_node&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, </span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">END</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">]</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">agent_builder.add_edge(</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;tool_node&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;llm_call&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Compile the agent</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">agent </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> agent_builder.compile()</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Show the agent</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">display(Image(agent.get_graph(</span><span style="color:#953800;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">xray</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">True</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">).draw_mermaid_png()))</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Invoke</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">messages </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> [HumanMessage(</span><span style="color:#953800;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">content</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;Add 3 and 4.&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)]</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">messages </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> agent.invoke({</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;messages&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: messages})</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">for</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> m </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">in</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> messages[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;messages&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">]:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    m.pretty_print()</span></span>
</code></pre></div></div><div data-fade-overlay="true" aria-hidden="true" style="--fade-color-light:#ffffff;--fade-color-dark:#0B0C0E"></div></div><div data-state="inactive" data-orientation="horizontal" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="radix-_R_33appbsnmkpt5qbsnpfdb_-trigger-1" hidden="" id="radix-_R_33appbsnmkpt5qbsnpfdb_-content-1" tabindex="-1" class="w-full min-w-full max-w-full h-full max-h-full relative"></div></div></div>

gap-1 text-sm text-gray-950/50 dark:text-white/50 group-hover:text-gray-950/70 dark:group-hover:text-white/70 rounded-none rounded-r-xl border px-3 border-gray-200 aspect-square dark:border-white/[0.07] bg-background-light dark:bg-background-dark hover:bg-gray-600/5 dark:hover:bg-gray-200/5" aria-label="More actions" type="button" id="radix-_R_2oppbsnmkpt5qbsnpfdb_" stroke-linecap="round"></path></svg></button></div></header><div class="mdx-content relative mt-8 mb-14 prose prose-gray dark:prose-invert [contain:inline-size] isolate" data-page-title="Durable execution" data-page-href="/oss/python/langgraph/durable-execution" id="content"><span data-as="p"><strong>Durable execution</strong> is a technique in which a process or workflow saves its progress at key points, allowing it to pause and later resume exactly where it left off. This is particularly useful in scenarios that require <a class="link" href="/oss/python/langgraph/interrupts">human-in-the-loop</a>, where users can inspect, validate, or modify the process before continuing, and in long-running tasks that might encounter interruptions or errors (e.g., calls to an LLM timing out). By preserving completed work, durable execution enables a process to resume without reprocessing previous steps — even after a significant delay (e.g., a week later).</span>
<span data-as="p">LangGraph’s built-in <a class="link" href="/oss/python/langgraph/persistence">persistence</a> layer provides durable execution for workflows, ensuring that the state of each execution step is saved to a durable store. This capability guarantees that if a workflow is interrupted — whether by a system failure or for <a class="link" href="/oss/python/langgraph/interrupts">human-in-the-loop</a> interactions — it can be resumed from its last recorded state.</span>
<div class="callout my-4 px-5 py-4 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl flex gap-3 border border-green-200 bg-green-50 dark:border-green-900 dark:bg-green-600/20 [&amp;_[data-component-part=&#x27;callout-icon&#x27;]]:mt-px" data-callout-type="tip"><div class="mt-0.5 w-4" data-component-part="callout-icon"><svg width="11" height="14" viewBox="0 0 11 14" fill="currentColor" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="text-green-800 dark:text-green-300 w-3.5 h-auto" aria-label="Tip"><path d="M3.12794 12.4232C3.12794 12.5954 3.1776 12.7634 3.27244 11.3513H3.12521L3.12794 12.4232ZM5.31288 0C2.52414 0.00875889 0.5 2.26889 0.5 4.78826C0.5 6.00188 0.949566 7.10829 1.69119 7.95492C2.14321 8.47011 2.84901 9.54727 3.11919 10.4557C3.12005 10.4625 2.68767 4.37534C2.68767 4.61719 2.88336 4.81288 3.12521 4.81288C3.36705 4.81288 3.56274 4.61599 3.56274 4.37534C3.56274 3.6515 4.1515 3.06274 4.87534 3.06274C5.11719 3.06274 5.31288 2.86727 5.31288 2.62548C5.31288 2.38369 5.11599 2.18767 4.87534 2.18767Z"></path></svg></div><div class="text-sm prose dark:prose-invert min-w-0 w-full [&amp;_kbd]:bg-background-light dark:[&amp;_kbd]:bg-background-dark [&amp;_code]:!text-current [&amp;_kbd]:!text-current [&amp;_a]:!text-current [&amp;_a]:border-current text-green-800 dark:text-green-300" data-component-part="callout-content"><span data-as="p">If you are using LangGraph with a checkpointer, you already have durable execution enabled. You can pause and resume workflows at any point, even after interruptions or failures.
To make the most of durable execution, ensure that your workflow is designed to be <a href="#determinism-and-consistent-replay" class="link">deterministic</a> and <a href="#determinism-and-consistent-replay" class="link">idempotent</a> and wrap any side effects or non-deterministic operations inside <a class="link" href="/oss/python/langgraph/functional-api#task">tasks</a>. You can use <a class="link" href="/oss/python/langgraph/functional-api#task">tasks</a> from both the <a class="link" href="/oss/python/langgraph/graph-api">StateGraph (Graph API)</a> and the <a class="link" href="/oss/python/langgraph/functional-api">Functional API</a>.</span></div></div>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="requirements"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#requirements" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Requirements</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">To leverage durable execution in LangGraph, you need to:</span>
<ol>
<li>
<span data-as="p">Enable <a class="link" href="/oss/python/langgraph/persistence">persistence</a> in your workflow by specifying a <a class="link" href="/oss/python/langgraph/persistence#checkpointer-libraries">checkpointer</a> that will save workflow progress.</span>
</li>
<li>
<span data-as="p">Specify a <a class="link" href="/oss/python/langgraph/persistence#threads">thread identifier</a> when executing a workflow. This will track the execution history for a particular instance of the workflow.</span>
</li>
<li>
<span data-as="p">Wrap any non-deterministic operations (e.g., random number generation) or operations with side effects (e.g., file writes, API calls) inside <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/func/#langgraph.func.task" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link">tasks</a> to ensure that when a workflow is resumed, these operations are not repeated for the particular run, and instead their results are retrieved from the persistence layer. For more information, see <a href="#determinism-and-consistent-replay" class="link">Determinism and Consistent Replay</a>.</span>
</li>
</ol>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="determinism-and-consistent-replay"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#determinism-and-consistent-replay" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Determinism and consistent replay</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">When you resume a workflow run, the code does <strong>NOT</strong> resume from the <strong>same line of code</strong> where execution stopped; instead, it will identify an appropriate <a href="#starting-points-for-resuming-workflows" class="link">starting point</a> from which to pick up where it left off. This means that the workflow will replay all steps from the <a href="#starting-points-for-resuming-workflows" class="link">starting point</a> until it reaches the point where it was stopped.</span>
<span data-as="p">As a result, when you are writing a workflow for durable execution, you must wrap any non-deterministic operations (e.g., random number generation) and any operations with side effects (e.g., file writes, API calls) inside <a class="link" href="/oss/python/langgraph/functional-api#task">tasks</a> or <a class="link" href="/oss/python/langgraph/graph-api#nodes">nodes</a>.</span>
<span data-as="p">To ensure that your workflow is deterministic and can be consistently replayed, follow these guidelines:</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Avoid Repeating Work</strong>: If a <a class="link" href="/oss/python/langgraph/graph-api#nodes">node</a> contains multiple operations with side effects (e.g., logging, file writes, or network calls), wrap each operation in a separate <strong>task</strong>. This ensures that when the workflow is resumed, the operations are not repeated, and their results are retrieved from the persistence layer.</li>
<li><strong>Encapsulate Non-Deterministic Operations:</strong> Wrap any code that might yield non-deterministic results (e.g., random number generation) inside <strong>tasks</strong> or <strong>nodes</strong>. This ensures that, upon resumption, the workflow follows the exact recorded sequence of steps with the same outcomes.</li>
<li><strong>Use Idempotent Operations</strong>: When possible ensure that side effects (e.g., API calls, file writes) are idempotent. This means that if an operation is retried after a failure in the workflow, it will have the same effect as the first time it was executed. This is particularly important for operations that result in data writes. In the event that a <strong>task</strong> starts but fails to complete successfully, the workflow’s resumption will re-run the <strong>task</strong>, relying on recorded outcomes to maintain consistency. Use idempotency keys or verify existing results to avoid unintended duplication, ensuring a smooth and predictable workflow execution.</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">For some examples of pitfalls to avoid, see the <a class="link" href="/oss/python/langgraph/functional-api#common-pitfalls">Common Pitfalls</a> section in the functional API, which shows
how to structure your code using <strong>tasks</strong> to avoid these issues. The same principles apply to the <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/graphs/#langgraph.graph.state.StateGraph" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link">StateGraph (Graph API)</a>.</span>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="durability-modes"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#durability-modes" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Durability modes</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">LangGraph supports three durability modes that allow you to balance performance and data consistency based on your application’s requirements. A higher durability mode adds more overhead to the workflow execution. You can specify the durability mode when calling any graph execution method:</span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    {</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;input&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;test&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">},</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>

<span data-as="p">The durability modes, from least to most durable, are as follows:</span>
<ul>
<li><code>&quot;exit&quot;</code>: LangGraph persists changes only when graph execution exits either successfully, with an error, or due to a human in the loop interrupt. This provides the best performance for long-running graphs but means intermediate state is not saved, so you cannot recover from system failures (like process crashes) that occur mid-execution.</li>
<li><code>&quot;async&quot;</code>: LangGraph persists changes asynchronously while the next step executes. This provides good performance and durability, but there’s a small risk that LangGraph does not write checkpoints if the process crashes during execution.</li>
<li><code>&quot;sync&quot;</code>: LangGraph persists changes synchronously before the next step starts. This ensures that LangGraph writes every checkpoint before continuing execution, providing high durability at the cost of some performance overhead.</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="using-tasks-in-nodes"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#using-tasks-in-nodes" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Using tasks in nodes</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">If a <a class="link" href="/oss/python/langgraph/graph-api#nodes">node</a> contains multiple operations, you may find it easier to convert each operation into a <strong>task</strong> rather than refactor the operations into individual nodes.</span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">checkpointer </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> InMemorySaver()</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Compile the graph with the checkpointer</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">graph </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> builder.compile(</span><span style="color:#953800;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">checkpointer</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">checkpointer)</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Define a config with a thread ID.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">thread_id </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> uuid.uuid4()</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">config </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> {</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;configurable&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: {</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;thread_id&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: thread_id}}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Invoke the graph</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">graph.invoke({</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;urls&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: [</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;https://www.example.com&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">]}, config)</span></span>
</code></pre></div></div><div data-fade-overlay="true" aria-hidden="true" style="--fade-color-light:#ffffff;--fade-color-dark:#0B0C0E"></div></div></div></div></div>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="resuming-workflows"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#resuming-workflows" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Resuming workflows</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">Once you have enabled durable execution in your workflow, you can resume execution for the following scenarios:</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Pausing and Resuming Workflows:</strong> Use the <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/types/#langgraph.types.interrupt" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link">interrupt</a> function to pause a workflow at specific points and the <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/types/#langgraph.types.Command" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>Command</code></a> primitive to resume it with updated state. See <a class="link" href="/oss/python/langgraph/interrupts"><strong>Interrupts</strong></a> for more details.</li>
<li><strong>Recovering from Failures:</strong> Automatically resume workflows from the last successful checkpoint after an exception (e.g., LLM provider outage). This involves executing the workflow with the same thread identifier by providing it with a <code>None</code> as the input value (see this <a class="link" href="/oss/python/langgraph/use-functional-api#resuming-after-an-error">example</a> with the functional API).</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="starting-points-for-resuming-workflows"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#starting-points-for-resuming-workflows" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Starting points for resuming workflows</span></h2>
<ul>
<li>If you’re using a <a class="link" href="/oss/python/langgraph/graph-api">StateGraph (Graph API)</a>, the starting point is the beginning of the <a class="link" href="/oss/python/langgraph/graph-api#nodes"><strong>node</strong></a> where execution stopped.</li>
<li>If you’re making a subgraph call inside a node, the starting point will be the <strong>parent</strong> node that called the subgraph that was halted.
Inside the subgraph, the starting point will be the specific <a class="link" href="/oss/python/langgraph/graph-api#nodes"><strong>node</strong></a> where execution stopped.</li>
<li>If you’re using the Functional API, the starting point is the beginning of the <a class="link" href="/oss/python/langgraph/functional-api#entrypoint"><strong>entrypoint</strong></a> where execution stopped.</li>
</ul>
