data-page-href="/oss/python/langgraph/streaming" id="content"><span data-as="p">LangGraph implements a streaming system to surface real-time updates. Streaming is crucial for enhancing the responsiveness of applications built on LLMs. By displaying output progressively, even before a complete response is ready, streaming significantly improves user experience (UX), particularly when dealing with the latency of LLMs.</span>
<span data-as="p">What’s possible with LangGraph streaming:</span>
<ul>
<li><svg class="icon inline bg-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-100" style="-webkit-mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/share-nodes.svg);-webkit-mask-repeat:no-repeat;-webkit-mask-position:center;mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/share-nodes.svg);mask-repeat:no-repeat;mask-position:center;width:16px;height:16px;display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle"></svg> <a href="#stream-graph-state" class="link"><strong>Stream graph state</strong></a> — get state updates / values with <code>updates</code> and <code>values</code> modes.</li>
<li><svg class="icon inline bg-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-100" style="-webkit-mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/square-poll-horizontal.svg);-webkit-mask-repeat:no-repeat;-webkit-mask-position:center;mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/square-poll-horizontal.svg);mask-repeat:no-repeat;mask-position:center;width:16px;height:16px;display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle"></svg> <a href="#stream-subgraph-outputs" class="link"><strong>Stream subgraph outputs</strong></a> — include outputs from both the parent graph and any nested subgraphs.</li>
<li><svg class="icon inline bg-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-100" style="-webkit-mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/square-binary.svg);-webkit-mask-repeat:no-repeat;-webkit-mask-position:center;mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/square-binary.svg);mask-repeat:no-repeat;mask-position:center;width:16px;height:16px;display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle"></svg> <a href="#messages" class="link"><strong>Stream LLM tokens</strong></a> — capture token streams from anywhere: inside nodes, subgraphs, or tools.</li>
<li><svg class="icon inline bg-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-100" style="-webkit-mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/table.svg);-webkit-mask-repeat:no-repeat;-webkit-mask-position:center;mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/table.svg);mask-repeat:no-repeat;mask-position:center;width:16px;height:16px;display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle"></svg> <a href="#stream-custom-data" class="link"><strong>Stream custom data</strong></a> — send custom updates or progress signals directly from tool functions.</li>
<li><svg class="icon inline bg-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-100" style="-webkit-mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/layer-plus.svg);-webkit-mask-repeat:no-repeat;-webkit-mask-position:center;mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/layer-plus.svg);mask-repeat:no-repeat;mask-position:center;width:16px;height:16px;display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle"></svg> <a href="#stream-multiple-modes" class="link"><strong>Use multiple streaming modes</strong></a> — choose from <code>values</code> (full state), <code>updates</code> (state deltas), <code>messages</code> (LLM tokens + metadata), <code>custom</code> (arbitrary user data), or <code>debug</code> (detailed traces).</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="supported-stream-modes"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#supported-stream-modes" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Supported stream modes</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">Pass one or more of the following stream modes as a list to the <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/graphs/#langgraph.graph.state.CompiledStateGraph.stream" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>stream</code></a> or <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/graphs/#langgraph.graph.state.CompiledStateGraph.astream" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>astream</code></a> methods:</span>
<div data-table-wrapper="true" class="[--page-padding:20px] overflow-x-auto flex w-[calc(100%+(var(--page-padding)*2))] my-[1em] py-[1em] -mx-[var(--page-padding)] max-w-none [contain:inline-size]"><div class="px-[var(--page-padding)] grow max-w-none table"><table class="m-0 min-w-full w-full max-w-none table [&amp;_td]:min-w-[150px] [&amp;_th]:text-left [&amp;_td[data-numeric]]:tabular-nums"><thead><tr><th>Mode</th><th>Description</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><code>values</code></td><td>Streams the full value of the state after each step of the graph.</td></tr><tr><td><code>updates</code></td><td>Streams the updates to the state after each step of the graph. If multiple updates are made in the same step (e.g., multiple nodes are run), those updates are streamed separately.</td></tr><tr><td><code>custom</code></td><td>Streams custom data from inside your graph nodes.</td></tr><tr><td><code>messages</code></td><td>Streams 2-tuples (LLM token, metadata) from any graph nodes where an LLM is invoked.</td></tr><tr><td><code>debug</code></td><td>Streams as much information as possible throughout the execution of the graph.</td></tr></tbody></table></div></div>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="basic-usage-example"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#basic-usage-example" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Basic usage example</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">LangGraph graphs expose the <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/pregel/#langgraph.pregel.Pregel.stream" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>stream</code></a> (sync) and <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/pregel/#langgraph.pregel.Pregel.astream" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>astream</code></a> (async) methods to yield streamed outputs as iterators.</span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">def</span><span style="color:#8250DF;--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA"> generate_joke</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">(</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">state</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: State):</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">    return</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> {</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;joke&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">f</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;This is a joke about </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">{</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">state[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&#x27;topic&#x27;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">]</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">}</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">graph </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> (</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    .add_node(generate_joke)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    .add_edge(</span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">START</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;refine_topic&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    .add_edge(</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;refine_topic&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;generate_joke&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    .add_edge(</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;generate_joke&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, </span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">END</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>

<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># The stream() method returns an iterator that yields streamed outputs</span></span>

<span data-as="p">Use the stream modes <code>updates</code> and <code>values</code> to stream the state of the graph as it executes.</span>
<ul>
<li><code>updates</code> streams the <strong>updates</strong> to the state after each step of the graph.</li>
<li><code>values</code> streams the <strong>full value</strong> of the state after each step of the graph.</li>
</ul>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">class</span><span style="color:#953800;--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0"> State</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">(</span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0">TypedDict</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">):</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">    return</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> {</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;topic&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: state[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;topic&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">] </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">+</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178"> &quot; and cats&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">def</span><span style="color:#8250DF;--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA"> generate_joke</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">(</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">state</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: State):</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">    return</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> {</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;joke&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">f</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;This is a joke about </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">{</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">state[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&#x27;topic&#x27;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">]</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">}</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">}</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">  .add_edge(</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;refine_topic&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;generate_joke&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>

<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="stream-subgraph-outputs"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#stream-subgraph-outputs" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Stream subgraph outputs</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">To include outputs from <a class="link" href="/oss/python/langgraph/use-subgraphs">subgraphs</a> in the streamed outputs, you can set <code>subgraphs=True</code> in the <code>.stream()</code> method of the parent graph. This will stream outputs from both the parent graph and any subgraphs.</span>
<span data-as="p">The outputs will be streamed as tuples <code>(namespace, data)</code>, where <code>namespace</code> is a tuple with the path to the node where a subgraph is invoked, e.g. <code>(&quot;parent_node:&lt;task_id&gt;&quot;, &quot;child_node:&lt;task_id&gt;&quot;)</code>.</span>

<a id="messages"></a>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="llm-tokens"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#llm-tokens" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">LLM tokens</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">Use the <code>messages</code> streaming mode to stream Large Language Model (LLM) outputs <strong>token by token</strong> from any part of your graph, including nodes, tools, subgraphs, or tasks.</span>
<span data-as="p">The streamed output from <a href="#supported-stream-modes" class="link"><code>messages</code> mode</a> is a tuple <code>(message_chunk, metadata)</code> where:</span>
<ul>
<li><code>message_chunk</code>: the token or message segment from the LLM.</li>
<li><code>metadata</code>: a dictionary containing details about the graph node and LLM invocation.</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<span data-as="p">If your LLM is not available as a LangChain integration, you can stream its outputs using <code>custom</code> mode instead. See <a href="#use-with-any-llm" class="link">use with any LLM</a> for details.</span>
</blockquote>
<div class="callout my-4 px-5 py-4 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl flex gap-3 border border-yellow-200 bg-yellow-50 dark:border-yellow-900 dark:bg-yellow-600/20 [&amp;_[data-component-part=&#x27;callout-icon&#x27;]]:mt-px" data-callout-type="warning"><div class="mt-0.5 w-4" data-component-part="callout-icon"><svg class="flex-none size-5 text-yellow-800 dark:text-yellow-300" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-label="Warning"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M12 9v2m0 4h.01m-6.938 4h13.856c1.54 0 2.502-1.667 1.732-3L13.732 4c-.77-1.333-2.694-1.333-3.464 0L3.34 16c-.77 1.333.192 3 1.732 3z"></path></svg></div><div class="text-sm prose dark:prose-invert min-w-0 w-full [&amp;_kbd]:bg-background-light dark:[&amp;_kbd]:bg-background-dark [&amp;_code]:!text-current [&amp;_kbd]:!text-current [&amp;_a]:!text-current [&amp;_a]:border-current text-yellow-800 dark:text-yellow-300" data-component-part="callout-content"><span data-as="p"><strong>Manual config required for async in Python &lt; 3.11</strong>
When using Python &lt; 3.11 with async code, you must explicitly pass <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langchain_core/runnables/#langchain_core.runnables.RunnableConfig" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>RunnableConfig</code></a> to <code>ainvoke()</code> to enable proper streaming. See <a href="#async" class="link">Async with Python &lt; 3.11</a> for details or upgrade to Python 3.11+.</span></div></div>

<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># The stream_mode is set to &quot;messages&quot; to stream LLM tokens</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># The metadata contains information about the LLM invocation, including the tags</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">async</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0"> for</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> msg, metadata </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">in</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> graph.astream(</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">      {</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;topic&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;cats&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">},</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#953800;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">      stream_mode</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;messages&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">):</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">    if</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> metadata[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;tags&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">] </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">==</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> [</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;joke&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">]:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA">        print</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">(msg.content, </span><span style="color:#953800;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">end</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;|&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, </span><span style="color:#953800;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">flush</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">True</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>
</code></pre></div></div><div data-fade-overlay="true" aria-hidden="true" style="--fade-color-light:#ffffff;--fade-color-dark:#0B0C0E"></div></div></div></details>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="filter-by-node"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#filter-by-node" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Filter by node</span></h4>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">graph </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> (</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">      .add_node(write_joke)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">      .add_node(write_poem)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955">      # write both the joke and the poem concurrently</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">      .add_edge(</span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">START</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;write_joke&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">      .add_edge(</span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">START</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;write_poem&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">      .compile()</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># The &quot;messages&quot; stream mode returns a tuple of (message_chunk, metadata)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># where message_chunk is the token streamed by the LLM and metadata is a dictionary</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># with information about the graph node where the LLM was called and other information</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">for</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> msg, metadata </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">in</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> graph.stream(</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    {</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;topic&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;cats&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">},</span></span>
<span class="line line-highlight"><span style="color:#953800;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">    stream_mode</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;messages&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">,  </span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">):</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955">    # Filter the streamed tokens by the langgraph_node field in the metadata</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955">    # to only include the tokens from the write_poem node</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">    if</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> msg.content </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">and</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> metadata[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;langgraph_node&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">] </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">==</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178"> &quot;write_poem&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA">        print</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">(msg.content, </span><span style="color:#953800;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">end</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;|&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, </span><span style="color:#953800;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">flush</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">True</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>
</code></pre></div></div><div data-fade-overlay="true" aria-hidden="true" style="--fade-color-light:#ffffff;--fade-color-dark:#0B0C0E"></div></div></div></details>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="stream-custom-data"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#stream-custom-data" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Stream custom data</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">To send <strong>custom user-defined data</strong> from inside a LangGraph node or tool, follow these steps:</span>
<ol>
<li>Use <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/config/#langgraph.config.get_stream_writer" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>get_stream_writer</code></a> to access the stream writer and emit custom data.</li>
<li>Set <code>stream_mode=&quot;custom&quot;</code> when calling <code>.stream()</code> or <code>.astream()</code> to get the custom data in the stream. You can combine multiple modes (e.g., <code>[&quot;updates&quot;, &quot;custom&quot;]</code>), but at least one must be <code>&quot;custom&quot;</code>.</li>
</ol>
<div class="callout my-4 px-5 py-4 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl flex gap-3 border border-yellow-200 bg-yellow-50 dark:border-yellow-900 dark:bg-yellow-600/20 [&amp;_[data-component-part=&#x27;callout-icon&#x27;]]:mt-px" data-callout-type="warning"><div class="mt-0.5 w-4" data-component-part="callout-icon"><svg class="flex-none size-5 text-yellow-800 dark:text-yellow-300" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-label="Warning"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M12 9v2m0 4h.01m-6.938 4h13.856c1.54 0 2.502-1.667 1.732-3L13.732 4c-.77-1.333-2.694-1.333-3.464 0L3.34 16c-.77 1.333.192 3 1.732 3z"></path></svg></div><div class="text-sm prose dark:prose-invert min-w-0 w-full [&amp;_kbd]:bg-background-light dark:[&amp;_kbd]:bg-background-dark [&amp;_code]:!text-current [&amp;_kbd]:!text-current [&amp;_a]:!text-current [&amp;_a]:border-current text-yellow-800 dark:text-yellow-300" data-component-part="callout-content"><span data-as="p"><strong>No <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/config/#langgraph.config.get_stream_writer" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>get_stream_writer</code></a> in async for Python &lt; 3.11</strong>
In async code running on Python &lt; 3.11, <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/config/#langgraph.config.get_stream_writer" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>get_stream_writer</code></a> will not work.
Instead, add a <code>writer</code> parameter to your node or tool and pass it manually.
See <a href="#async" class="link">Async with Python &lt; 3.11</a> for usage examples.</span></div></div>

<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="use-with-any-llm"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#use-with-any-llm" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Use with any LLM</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">You can use <code>stream_mode=&quot;custom&quot;</code> to stream data from <strong>any LLM API</strong> — even if that API does <strong>not</strong> implement the LangChain chat model interface.</span>
<span data-as="p">This lets you integrate raw LLM clients or external services that provide their own streaming interfaces, making LangGraph highly flexible for custom setups.</span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">                {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">                    &quot;id&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;1&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">                    &quot;function&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">                        &quot;arguments&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&#x27;{&quot;place&quot;:&quot;bedroom&quot;}&#x27;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">                        &quot;name&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;get_items&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">                    },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">                    &quot;type&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;function&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">                }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">            ],</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">        }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    ]</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">async</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0"> for</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> chunk </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">in</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> graph.astream(</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">):</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA">    print</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">(chunk[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;content&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">], </span><span style="color:#953800;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">end</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;|&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, </span><span style="color:#953800;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">flush</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">True</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>
</code></pre></div></div><div data-fade-overlay="true" aria-hidden="true" style="--fade-color-light:#ffffff;--fade-color-dark:#0B0C0E"></div></div></div></details>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="disable-streaming-for-specific-chat-models"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#disable-streaming-for-specific-chat-models" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Disable streaming for specific chat models</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">If your application mixes models that support streaming with those that do not, you may need to explicitly disable streaming for
models that do not support it.</span>
<span data-as="p">Set <code>streaming=False</code> when initializing the model.</span>

<a id="async"></a>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="async-with-python-&lt;-3-11"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#async-with-python-&lt;-3-11" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Async with Python &lt; 3.11</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">In Python versions &lt; 3.11, <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/asyncio-task.html#asyncio.create_task" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link">asyncio tasks</a> do not support the <code>context</code> parameter.
This limits LangGraph ability to automatically propagate context, and affects LangGraph’s streaming mechanisms in two key ways:</span>
<ol>
<li>You <strong>must</strong> explicitly pass <a href="https://python.langchain.com/docs/concepts/runnables/#runnableconfig" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>RunnableConfig</code></a> into async LLM calls (e.g., <code>ainvoke()</code>), as callbacks are not automatically propagated.</li>
<li>You <strong>cannot</strong> use <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/config/#langgraph.config.get_stream_writer" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>get_stream_writer</code></a> in async nodes or tools — you must pass a <code>writer</code> argument directly.</li>
</ol>

gap-1 text-sm text-gray-950/50 dark:text-white/50 group-hover:text-gray-950/70 dark:group-hover:text-white/70 rounded-none rounded-r-xl border px-3 border-gray-200 aspect-square dark:border-white/[0.07] bg-background-light dark:bg-background-dark hover:bg-gray-600/5 dark:hover:bg-gray-200/5" aria-label="More actions" type="button" id="radix-_R_2oppbsnmkpt5qbsnpfdb_" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded="false" data-state="closed"><svg width="8" height="24" viewBox="0 -9 3 24" class="transition-transform text-gray-400 overflow-visible group-hover:text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-600 dark:group-hover:text-gray-400 rotate-90"><path d="M0 0L3 3L0 6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"></path></svg></button></div></header><div class="mdx-content relative mt-8 mb-14 prose prose-gray dark:prose-invert [contain:inline-size] isolate" data-page-title="Interrupts" data-page-href="/oss/python/langgraph/interrupts" id="content"><span data-as="p">Interrupts allow you to pause graph execution at specific points and wait for external input before continuing. This enables human-in-the-loop patterns where you need external input to proceed. When an interrupt is triggered, LangGraph saves the graph state using its <a class="link" href="/oss/python/langgraph/persistence">persistence</a> layer and waits indefinitely until you resume execution.</span>
<span data-as="p">Interrupts work by calling the <code>interrupt()</code> function at any point in your graph nodes. The function accepts any JSON-serializable value which is surfaced to the caller. When you’re ready to continue, you resume execution by re-invoking the graph using <code>Command</code>, which then becomes the return value of the <code>interrupt()</code> call from inside the node.</span>
<span data-as="p">Unlike static breakpoints (which pause before or after specific nodes), interrupts are <strong>dynamic</strong>—they can be placed anywhere in your code and can be conditional based on your application logic.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Checkpointing keeps your place:</strong> the checkpointer writes the exact graph state so you can resume later, even when in an error state.</li>
<li><strong><code>thread_id</code> is your pointer:</strong> set <code>config={&quot;configurable&quot;: {&quot;thread_id&quot;: ...}}</code> to tell the checkpointer which state to load.</li>
<li><strong>Interrupt payloads surface as <code>__interrupt__</code>:</strong> the values you pass to <code>interrupt()</code> return to the caller in the <code>__interrupt__</code> field so you know what the graph is waiting on.</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">The <code>thread_id</code> you choose is effectively your persistent cursor. Reusing it resumes the same checkpoint; using a new value starts a brand-new thread with an empty state.</span>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="pause-using-interrupt"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#pause-using-interrupt" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Pause using <code>interrupt</code></span></h2>
<span data-as="p">The <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/types/#langgraph.types.interrupt" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>interrupt</code></a> function pauses graph execution and returns a value to the caller. When you call <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/types/#langgraph.types.interrupt" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>interrupt</code></a> within a node, LangGraph saves the current graph state and waits for you to resume execution with input.</span>
<span data-as="p">To use <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/types/#langgraph.types.interrupt" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>interrupt</code></a>, you need:</span>
<ol>
<li>A <strong>checkpointer</strong> to persist the graph state (use a durable checkpointer in production)</li>
<li>A <strong>thread ID</strong> in your config so the runtime knows which state to resume from</li>
<li>To call <code>interrupt()</code> where you want to pause (payload must be JSON-serializable)</li>
</ol>
<div class="code-block mt-5 mb-8 not-prose rounded-2xl relative group text-gray-950 dark:text-gray-50 codeblock-light border border-gray-950/10 dark:border-white/10 dark:twoslash-dark bg-transparent <span class="line"></span>

</code></pre></div></div><div data-fade-overlay="true" aria-hidden="true" style="--fade-color-light:#ffffff;--fade-color-dark:#0B0C0E"></div></div>
<span data-as="p">When you call <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/types/#langgraph.types.interrupt" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>interrupt</code></a>, here’s what happens:</span>
<ol>
<li><strong>Graph execution gets suspended</strong> at the exact point where <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/types/#langgraph.types.interrupt" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>interrupt</code></a> is called</li>
<li><strong>State is saved</strong> using the checkpointer so execution can be resumed later, In production, this should be a persistent checkpointer (e.g. backed by a database)</li>
<li><strong>Value is returned</strong> to the caller under <code>__interrupt__</code>; it can be any JSON-serializable value (string, object, array, etc.)</li>
<li><strong>Graph waits indefinitely</strong> until you resume execution with a response</li>
<li><strong>Response is passed back</strong> into the node when you resume, becoming the return value of the <code>interrupt()</code> call</li>
</ol>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="resuming-interrupts"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#resuming-interrupts" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Resuming interrupts</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">After an interrupt pauses execution, you resume the graph by invoking it again with a <code>Command</code> that contains the resume value. The resume value is passed back to the <code>interrupt</code> call, allowing the node to continue execution with the external input.</span>

<span data-as="p"><strong>Key points about resuming:</strong></span>
<ul>
<li>You must use the <strong>same thread ID</strong> when resuming that was used when the interrupt occurred</li>
<li>The value passed to <code>Command(resume=...)</code> becomes the return value of the <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/types/#langgraph.types.interrupt" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>interrupt</code></a> call</li>
<li>The node restarts from the beginning of the node where the <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/types/#langgraph.types.interrupt" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>interrupt</code></a> was called when resumed, so any code before the <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/types/#langgraph.types.interrupt" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>interrupt</code></a> runs again</li>
<li>You can pass any JSON-serializable value as the resume value</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="common-patterns"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#common-patterns" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Common patterns</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">The key thing that interrupts unlock is the ability to pause execution and wait for external input. This is useful for a variety of use cases, including:</span>
<ul>
<li><svg class="icon inline bg-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-100" style="-webkit-mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/check-circle.svg);-webkit-mask-repeat:no-repeat;-webkit-mask-position:center;mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/check-circle.svg);mask-repeat:no-repeat;mask-position:center;width:16px;height:16px;display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle"></svg> <a href="#approve-or-reject" class="link">Approval workflows</a>: Pause before executing critical actions (API calls, database changes, financial transactions)</li>
<li><svg class="icon inline bg-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-100" style="-webkit-mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/pencil.svg);-webkit-mask-repeat:no-repeat;-webkit-mask-position:center;mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/pencil.svg);mask-repeat:no-repeat;mask-position:center;width:16px;height:16px;display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle"></svg> <a href="#review-and-edit-state" class="link">Review and edit</a>: Let humans review and modify LLM outputs or tool calls before continuing</li>
<li><svg class="icon inline bg-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-100" style="-webkit-mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/wrench.svg);-webkit-mask-repeat:no-repeat;-webkit-mask-position:center;mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/wrench.svg);mask-repeat:no-repeat;mask-position:center;width:16px;height:16px;display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle"></svg> <a href="#interrupts-in-tools" class="link">Interrupting tool calls</a>: Pause before executing tool calls to review and edit the tool call before execution</li>
<li><svg class="icon inline bg-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-100" style="-webkit-mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/shield-check.svg);-webkit-mask-repeat:no-repeat;-webkit-mask-position:center;mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/shield-check.svg);mask-repeat:no-repeat;mask-position:center;width:16px;height:16px;display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle"></svg> <a href="#validating-human-input" class="link">Validating human input</a>: Pause before proceeding to the next step to validate human input</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="stream-with-human-in-the-loop-hitl-interrupts"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#stream-with-human-in-the-loop-hitl-interrupts" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Stream with human-in-the-loop (HITL) interrupts</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">When building interactive agents with human-in-the-loop workflows, you can stream both message chunks and node updates simultaneously to provide real-time feedback while handling interrupts.</span>
<span data-as="p">Use multiple stream modes (<code>&quot;messages&quot;</code> and <code>&quot;updates&quot;</code>) with <code>subgraphs=True</code> (if subgraphs are present) to:</span>
<ul>
<li>Stream AI responses in real-time as they’re generated</li>
<li>Detect when the graph encounters an interrupt</li>
<li>Handle user input and resume execution seamlessly</li>
</ul>

<ul>
<li><strong><code>stream_mode=[&quot;messages&quot;, &quot;updates&quot;]</code></strong>: Enables dual streaming of both message chunks and graph state updates</li>
<li><strong><code>subgraphs=True</code></strong>: Required for interrupt detection in nested graphs</li>
<li><strong><code>&quot;__interrupt__&quot;</code> detection</strong>: Signals when human input is needed</li>
<li><strong><code>Command(resume=...)</code></strong>: Resumes graph execution with user-provided data</li>
</ul>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">        return</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> Command(</span><span style="color:#953800;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">goto</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;cancel&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>
</code></pre></div></div><div data-fade-overlay="true" aria-hidden="true" style="--fade-color-light:#ffffff;--fade-color-dark:#0B0C0E"></div></div>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA">print</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">(initial[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;__interrupt__&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">])  </span><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># -&gt; [Interrupt(value={&#x27;question&#x27;: ..., &#x27;details&#x27;: ...})]</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Resume with the decision; True routes to proceed, False to cancel</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA">print</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">(resumed[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;status&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">])  </span><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># -&gt; &quot;approved&quot;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">graph </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> builder.compile(</span><span style="color:#953800;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">checkpointer</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">checkpointer)</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">config </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> {</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;configurable&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: {</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;thread_id&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;review-42&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">}}</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA">print</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">(initial[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;__interrupt__&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">])  </span><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># -&gt; [Interrupt(value={&#x27;instruction&#x27;: ..., &#x27;content&#x27;: ...})]</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Resume with the edited text from the reviewer</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">final_state </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> graph.invoke(</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    Command(</span><span style="color:#953800;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">resume</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;Improved draft after review&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">),</span></span>

<span data-as="p">You can also place interrupts directly inside tool functions. This makes the tool itself pause for approval whenever it’s called, and allows for human review and editing of the tool call before it is executed.</span>
<span data-as="p">First, define a tool that uses <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/types/#langgraph.types.interrupt" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>interrupt</code></a>:</span>

<span data-as="p">This approach is useful when you want the approval logic to live with the tool itself, making it reusable across different parts of your graph. The LLM can call the tool naturally, and the interrupt will pause execution whenever the tool is invoked, allowing you to approve, edit, or cancel the action.</span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    response </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> interrupt({</span></span>

<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955">        # Actually send the email (your implementation here)</span></span>

<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="validating-human-input"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#validating-human-input" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Validating human input</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Sometimes you need to validate input from humans and ask again if it’s invalid. You can do this using multiple <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/types/#langgraph.types.interrupt" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>interrupt</code></a> calls in a loop.</span>

<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Provide valid data; loop exits and state updates</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">final </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> graph.invoke(Command(</span><span style="color:#953800;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">resume</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#B5CEA8">30</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">), </span><span style="color:#953800;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">config</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">config)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA">print</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">(final[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;age&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">])  </span><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># -&gt; 30</span></span>
</code></pre></div></div><div data-fade-overlay="true" aria-hidden="true" style="--fade-color-light:#ffffff;--fade-color-dark:#0B0C0E"></div></div></div></details>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="rules-of-interrupts"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#rules-of-interrupts" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Rules of interrupts</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">When you call <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/types/#langgraph.types.interrupt" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>interrupt</code></a> within a node, LangGraph suspends execution by raising an exception that signals the runtime to pause. This exception propagates up through the call stack and is caught by the runtime, which notifies the graph to save the current state and wait for external input.</span>
<span data-as="p">When execution resumes (after you provide the requested input), the runtime restarts the entire node from the beginning—it does not resume from the exact line where <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/types/#langgraph.types.interrupt" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>interrupt</code></a> was called. This means any code that ran before the <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/types/#langgraph.types.interrupt" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>interrupt</code></a> will execute again. Because of this, there’s a few important rules to follow when working with interrupts to ensure they behave as expected.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="do-not-wrap-interrupt-calls-in-try/except"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#do-not-wrap-interrupt-calls-in-try/except" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Do not wrap <code>interrupt</code> calls in try/except</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">The way that <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/types/#langgraph.types.interrupt" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>interrupt</code></a> pauses execution at the point of the call is by throwing a special exception. If you wrap the <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/types/#langgraph.types.interrupt" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>interrupt</code></a> call in a try/except block, you will catch this exception and the interrupt will not be passed back to the graph.</span>
<ul>
<li>✅ Separate <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/types/#langgraph.types.interrupt" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>interrupt</code></a> calls from error-prone code</li>
<li>✅ Use specific exception types in try/except blocks</li>
</ul>

<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="do-not-reorder-interrupt-calls-within-a-node"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#do-not-reorder-interrupt-calls-within-a-node" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Do not reorder <code>interrupt</code> calls within a node</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">It’s common to use multiple interrupts in a single node, however this can lead to unexpected behavior if not handled carefully.</span>
<span data-as="p">When a node contains multiple interrupt calls, LangGraph keeps a list of resume values specific to the task executing the node. Whenever execution resumes, it starts at the beginning of the node. For each interrupt encountered, LangGraph checks if a matching value exists in the task’s resume list. Matching is <strong>strictly index-based</strong>, so the order of interrupt calls within the node is important.</span>
<ul>
<li>✅ Keep <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/types/#langgraph.types.interrupt" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>interrupt</code></a> calls consistent across node executions</li>
</ul>

dark:bg-transparent" numberOfLines="11" language="python"><div data-floating-buttons="true" class="absolute top-3 right-4 flex items-center gap-1.5"><div class="z-10 relative select-none"><button class="h-[26px] w-[26px] flex items-center justify-center rounded-md backdrop-blur peer group/copy-button " data-testid="copy-code-button" aria-label="Copy the contents from the code block"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 18 18" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="w-4 h-4 text-gray-400 group-hover/copy-button:text-gray-500 dark:text-white/40 dark:group-hover/copy-button:text-white/60"><path d="M14.25 5.25H7.25C6.14543 5.25 5.25 6.14543 5.25 7.25V14.25C5.25 15.3546 6.14543 16.25 7.25 16.25H14.25C15.3546 16.25 16.25 15.3546 16.25 14.25V7.25C16.25 6.14543 15.3546 5.25 14.25 5.25Z" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path><path d="M2.80103 11.998L1.77203 5.07397C1.61003 <ul>
<li>🔴 Do not conditionally skip <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/types/#langgraph.types.interrupt" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>interrupt</code></a> calls within a node</li>

<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="do-not-return-complex-values-in-interrupt-calls"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#do-not-return-complex-values-in-interrupt-calls" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Do not return complex values in <code>interrupt</code> calls</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Depending on which checkpointer is used, complex values may not be serializable (e.g. you can’t serialize a function). To make your graphs adaptable to any deployment, it’s best practice to only use values that can be reasonably serialized.</span>
<ul>
<li>✅ Pass simple, JSON-serializable types to <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/types/#langgraph.types.interrupt" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>interrupt</code></a></li>
<li>✅ Pass dictionaries/objects with simple values</li>
</ul>

<ul>
<li>🔴 Do not pass functions, class instances, or other complex objects to <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/types/#langgraph.types.interrupt" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>interrupt</code></a></li>
</ul>

<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="side-effects-called-before-interrupt-must-be-idempotent"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#side-effects-called-before-interrupt-must-be-idempotent" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Side effects called before <code>interrupt</code> must be idempotent</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Because interrupts work by re-running the nodes they were called from, side effects called before <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/types/#langgraph.types.interrupt" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>interrupt</code></a> should (ideally) be idempotent. For context, idempotency means that the same operation can be applied multiple times without changing the result beyond the initial execution.</span>
<span data-as="p">As an example, you might have an API call to update a record inside of a node. If <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/types/#langgraph.types.interrupt" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>interrupt</code></a> is called after that call is made, it will be re-run multiple times when the node is resumed, potentially overwriting the initial update or creating duplicate records.</span>
<ul>
<li>✅ Use idempotent operations before <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/types/#langgraph.types.interrupt" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>interrupt</code></a></li>
<li>✅ Place side effects after <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/types/#langgraph.types.interrupt" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>interrupt</code></a> calls</li>
<li>✅ Separate side effects into separate nodes when possible</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">When invoking a subgraph within a node, the parent graph will resume execution from the <strong>beginning of the node</strong> where the subgraph was invoked and the <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/types/#langgraph.types.interrupt" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>interrupt</code></a> was triggered. Similarly, the <strong>subgraph</strong> will also resume from the beginning of the node where <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/types/#langgraph.types.interrupt" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>interrupt</code></a> was called.</span>
