<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="debugging-with-interrupts"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#debugging-with-interrupts" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Debugging with interrupts</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">To debug and test a graph, you can use static interrupts as breakpoints to step through the graph execution one node at a time. Static interrupts are triggered at defined points either before or after a node executes. You can set these by specifying <code>interrupt_before</code> and <code>interrupt_after</code> when compiling the graph.</span>
<div class="callout my-4 px-5 py-4 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl flex gap-3 border border-blue-200 bg-blue-50 dark:border-blue-900 dark:bg-blue-600/20" data-callout-type="note"><div class="mt-0.5 w-4" data-component-part="callout-icon"><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 14 14" fill="currentColor" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="size-4 text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-300" aria-label="Note"><path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M7 1.3C10.14 1.3 12.7 3.86 12.7 7C12.7 10.14 10.14 12.7 7 12.7C5.48908 12.6974 4.0408 12.096 2.97241 11.0276C1.90403 9.9592 1.30264 8.51092 1.3 7C1.3 3.86 3.86 1.3 7 1.3ZM7 0C3.14 0 0 3.14 0 7C0 10.86 3.14 14 7 14C10.86 14 14 10.86 14 7C14 3.14 10.86 0 7 0ZM8 3H6V8H8V3ZM8 9H6V11H8V9Z"></path></svg></div><div class="text-sm prose dark:prose-invert min-w-0 w-full [&amp;_kbd]:bg-background-light dark:[&amp;_kbd]:bg-background-dark [&amp;_code]:!text-current [&amp;_kbd]:!text-current [&amp;_a]:!text-current [&amp;_a]:border-current text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-300" data-component-part="callout-content"><span data-as="p">Static interrupts are <strong>not</strong> recommended for human-in-the-loop workflows. Use the <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/types/#langgraph.types.interrupt" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>interrupt</code></a> function instead.</span></div></div>

language="python" numberOfLines="18"><span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">graph </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> builder.compile(</span></span>
<span class="line line-highlight"><span style="color:#953800;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">    interrupt_before</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;node_a&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">],  </span></span>
<span class="line line-highlight"><span style="color:#953800;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">    interrupt_after</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;node_b&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;node_c&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">],  </span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#953800;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">    checkpointer</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">checkpointer,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Pass a thread ID to the graph</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">config </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> {</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">        &quot;thread_id&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;some_thread&quot;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Run the graph until the breakpoint</span></span>
<span class="line line-highlight"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">graph.invoke(inputs, </span><span style="color:#953800;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">config</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">config)  </span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#6A9955"># Resume the graph</span></span>
<span class="line line-highlight"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">graph.invoke(</span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">None</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, </span><span style="color:#953800;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">config</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">config)  </span></span>
</code></pre></div></div><div data-fade-overlay="true" aria-hidden="true" style="--fade-color-light:#ffffff;--fade-color-dark:#0B0C0E"></div></div><ol>
<li>The breakpoints are set during <code>compile</code> time.</li>
<li><code>interrupt_before</code> specifies the nodes where execution should pause before the node is executed.</li>
<li><code>interrupt_after</code> specifies the nodes where execution should pause after the node is executed.</li>
<li>A checkpointer is required to enable breakpoints.</li>
<li>The graph is run until the first breakpoint is hit.</li>
<li>The graph is resumed by passing in <code>None</code> for the input. This will run the graph until the next breakpoint is hit.</li>
</ol></div><div id="panel-at-run-time-1" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="at-run-time" class="prose dark:prose-dark overflow-x-auto [&amp;_[data-table-wrapper]]:![--page-padding:0px] <span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>

<span class="line line-highlight"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">graph.invoke(</span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">None</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, </span><span style="color:#953800;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">config</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">config)  </span></span>
</code></pre></div></div><div data-fade-overlay="true" aria-hidden="true" style="--fade-color-light:#ffffff;--fade-color-dark:#0B0C0E"></div></div><ol>
<li><code>graph.invoke</code> is called with the <code>interrupt_before</code> and <code>interrupt_after</code> parameters. This is a run-time configuration and can be changed for every invocation.</li>
<li><code>interrupt_before</code> specifies the nodes where execution should pause before the node is executed.</li>
<li><code>interrupt_after</code> specifies the nodes where execution should pause after the node is executed.</li>
<li>The graph is run until the first breakpoint is hit.</li>
<li>The graph is resumed by passing in <code>None</code> for the input. This will run the graph until the next breakpoint is hit.</li>
</ol></div></div></div>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="using-langsmith-studio"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#using-langsmith-studio" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Using LangSmith Studio</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">You can use <a class="link" href="/langsmith/studio">LangSmith Studio</a> to set static interrupts in your graph in the UI before running the graph. You can also use the UI to inspect the graph state at any point in the execution.</span>

time-travel" data-page-href="/oss/python/langgraph/use-time-travel" id="content"><span data-as="p">When working with non-deterministic systems that make model-based decisions (e.g., agents powered by LLMs), it can be useful to examine their decision-making process in detail:</span>
<ol>
<li><svg class="icon inline bg-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-100" style="-webkit-mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/lightbulb.svg);-webkit-mask-repeat:no-repeat;-webkit-mask-position:center;mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/lightbulb.svg);mask-repeat:no-repeat;mask-position:center;width:16px;height:16px;display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle"></svg> <strong>Understand reasoning</strong>: Analyze the steps that led to a successful result.</li>
<li><svg class="icon inline bg-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-100" style="-webkit-mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/bug.svg);-webkit-mask-repeat:no-repeat;-webkit-mask-position:center;mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/bug.svg);mask-repeat:no-repeat;mask-position:center;width:16px;height:16px;display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle"></svg> <strong>Debug mistakes</strong>: Identify where and why errors occurred.</li>
<li><svg class="icon inline bg-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-100" style="-webkit-mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/magnifying-glass.svg);-webkit-mask-repeat:no-repeat;-webkit-mask-position:center;mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/magnifying-glass.svg);mask-repeat:no-repeat;mask-position:center;width:16px;height:16px;display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle"></svg> <strong>Explore alternatives</strong>: Test different paths to uncover better solutions.</li>
</ol>
<span data-as="p">LangGraph provides time-travel functionality to support these use cases. Specifically, you can resume execution from a prior checkpoint — either replaying the same state or modifying it to explore alternatives. In all cases, resuming past execution produces a new fork in the history.</span>
<span data-as="p">To use time-travel in LangGraph:</span>
<ol>
<li><a href="#1-run-the-graph" class="link">Run the graph</a> with initial inputs using <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/graphs/#langgraph.graph.state.CompiledStateGraph.invoke" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>invoke</code></a> or <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/graphs/#langgraph.graph.state.CompiledStateGraph.stream" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>stream</code></a> methods.</li>
<li><a href="#2-identify-a-checkpoint" class="link">Identify a checkpoint in an existing thread</a>: Use the <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/graphs/#langgraph.graph.state.CompiledStateGraph.get_state_history" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>get_state_history</code></a> method to retrieve the execution history for a specific <code>thread_id</code> and locate the desired <code>checkpoint_id</code>.
Alternatively, set an <a class="link" href="/oss/python/langgraph/interrupts">interrupt</a> before the node(s) where you want execution to pause. You can then find the most recent checkpoint recorded up to that interrupt.</li>
<li><a href="#3-update-the-state-optional" class="link">Update the graph state (optional)</a>: Use the <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/graphs/#langgraph.graph.state.CompiledStateGraph.update_state" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>update_state</code></a> method to modify the graph’s state at the checkpoint and resume execution from alternative state.</li>
<li><a href="#4-resume-execution-from-the-checkpoint" class="link">Resume execution from the checkpoint</a>: Use the <code>invoke</code> or <code>stream</code> methods with an input of <code>None</code> and a configuration containing the appropriate <code>thread_id</code> and <code>checkpoint_id</code>.</li>
</ol>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="in-a-workflow"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#in-a-workflow" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">In a workflow</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">This example builds a simple LangGraph workflow that generates a joke topic and writes a joke using an LLM. It demonstrates how to run the graph, retrieve past execution checkpoints, optionally modify the state, and resume execution from a chosen checkpoint to explore alternate outcomes.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="setup"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#setup" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Setup</span></h3>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    topic: NotRequired[</span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0">str</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">]</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    joke: NotRequired[</span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0">str</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">]</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">    &quot;claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#953800;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">    temperature</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#B5CEA8">0</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">,</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">            {</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;role&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;system&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;content&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">f</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;You are a helpful assistant.</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D7BA7D">\n</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">{</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">memories</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#569CD6">}</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">},</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">            *</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">state[</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;messages&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">],</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">        ]</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    )</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">    return</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> {</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;messages&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: [response]}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">builder.add_node(chat)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">builder.add_edge(</span><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">START</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;chat&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">graph </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> builder.compile(</span><span style="color:#953800;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">store</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">store)</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">for</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> message, metadata </span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">in</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4"> graph.stream(</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#953800;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">    input</span><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">=</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">{</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;messages&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: [{</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;role&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;user&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">, </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;content&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">: </span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">&quot;I&#x27;m hungry&quot;</span><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">}]},</span></span>

<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="manage-short-term-memory"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#manage-short-term-memory" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Manage short-term memory</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">With <a href="#add-short-term-memory" class="link">short-term memory</a> enabled, long conversations can exceed the LLM’s context window. Common solutions are:</span>
<ul>
<li><a href="#trim-messages" class="link">Trim messages</a>: Remove first or last N messages (before calling LLM)</li>
<li><a href="#delete-messages" class="link">Delete messages</a> from LangGraph state permanently</li>
<li><a href="#summarize-messages" class="link">Summarize messages</a>: Summarize earlier messages in the history and replace them with a summary</li>
<li><a href="#manage-checkpoints" class="link">Manage checkpoints</a> to store and retrieve message history</li>
<li>Custom strategies (e.g., message filtering, etc.)</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">This allows the agent to keep track of the conversation without exceeding the LLM’s context window.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="trim-messages"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#trim-messages" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Trim messages</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Most LLMs have a maximum supported context window (denominated in tokens). One way to decide when to truncate messages is to count the tokens in the message history and truncate whenever it approaches that limit. If you’re using LangChain, you can use the trim messages utility and specify the number of tokens to keep from the list, as well as the <code>strategy</code> (e.g., keep the last <code>max_tokens</code>) to use for handling the boundary.</span>
<span data-as="p">To trim message history, use the <a href="https://python.langchain.com/api_reference/core/messages/langchain_core.messages.utils.trim_messages.html" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>trim_messages</code></a> function:</span>

<span data-as="p">You can delete messages from the graph state to manage the message history. This is useful when you want to remove specific messages or clear the entire message history.</span>
<span data-as="p">To delete messages from the graph state, you can use the <code>RemoveMessage</code>. For <code>RemoveMessage</code> to work, you need to use a state key with <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/graphs/#langgraph.graph.message.add_messages" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>add_messages</code></a> <a class="link" href="/oss/python/langgraph/graph-api#reducers">reducer</a>, like <a class="link" href="/oss/python/langgraph/graph-api#messagesstate"><code>MessagesState</code></a>.</span>
<span data-as="p">To remove specific messages:</span>

<span class="line"><span>[(&#x27;human&#x27;, &quot;hi! I&#x27;m bob&quot;), (&#x27;ai&#x27;, &#x27;Hi Bob! How are you doing today? Is there anything I can help you with?&#x27;), (&#x27;human&#x27;, &quot;what&#x27;s my name?&quot;)]</span></span>
<span class="line"><span>[(&#x27;human&#x27;, &quot;hi! I&#x27;m bob&quot;), (&#x27;ai&#x27;, &#x27;Hi Bob! How are you doing today? Is there anything I can help you with?&#x27;), (&#x27;human&#x27;, &quot;what&#x27;s my name?&quot;), (&#x27;ai&#x27;, &#x27;Your name is Bob.&#x27;)]</span></span>

<span class="line"><span></span></span></code></pre></div></div><div data-fade-overlay="true" aria-hidden="true" style="--fade-color-light:#ffffff;--fade-color-dark:#0B0C0E"></div></div></div></details>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="summarize-messages"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#summarize-messages" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Summarize messages</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">The problem with trimming or removing messages, as shown above, is that you may lose information from culling of the message queue. Because of this, some applications benefit from a more sophisticated approach of summarizing the message history using a chat model.</span>
<span aria-owns="rmiz-modal-" data-rmiz=""><span data-rmiz-content="not-found" style="visibility:visible"><picture class="contents"><img data-path="oss/images/summary.png" src="https://mintcdn.com/langchain-5e9cc07a/ybiAaBfoBvFquMDz/oss/images/summary.png?fit=max&amp;auto=format&amp;n=ybiAaBfoBvFquMDz&amp;q=85&amp;s=c8ed3facdccd4ef5c7e52902c72ba938" alt="Summary" class="object-contain" width="609" height="242" decoding="async" sizes="(max-width: 1024px) 100vw, 704px" srcSet="https://mintcdn.com/langchain-5e9cc07a/ybiAaBfoBvFquMDz/oss/images/summary.png?w=280&amp;fit=max&amp;auto=format&amp;n=ybiAaBfoBvFquMDz&amp;q=85&amp;s=4208b9b0cc9f459f3dc4e5219918471b 280w, https://mintcdn.com/langchain-5e9cc07a/ybiAaBfoBvFquMDz/oss/images/summary.png?w=560&amp;fit=max&amp;auto=format&amp;n=ybiAaBfoBvFquMDz&amp;q=85&amp;s=7acb77c081545f57042368f4e9d0c8cb 560w, https://mintcdn.com/langchain-5e9cc07a/ybiAaBfoBvFquMDz/oss/images/summary.png?w=840&amp;fit=max&amp;auto=format&amp;n=ybiAaBfoBvFquMDz&amp;q=85&amp;s=2fcfdb0c481d2e1d361e76db763a41e5 840w, https://mintcdn.com/langchain-5e9cc07a/ybiAaBfoBvFquMDz/oss/images/summary.png?w=1100&amp;fit=max&amp;auto=format&amp;n=ybiAaBfoBvFquMDz&amp;q=85&amp;s=4abdac693a562788aa0db8681bef8ea7 1100w, https://mintcdn.com/langchain-5e9cc07a/ybiAaBfoBvFquMDz/oss/images/summary.png?w=1650&amp;fit=max&amp;auto=format&amp;n=ybiAaBfoBvFquMDz&amp;q=85&amp;s=40acfefa91dcb11b247a6e4a7705f22b 1650w, https://mintcdn.com/langchain-5e9cc07a/ybiAaBfoBvFquMDz/oss/images/summary.png?w=2500&amp;fit=max&amp;auto=format&amp;n=ybiAaBfoBvFquMDz&amp;q=85&amp;s=8d765aaf7551e8b0fc2720de7d2ac2a8 2500w" data-optimize="true" style="aspect-ratio:609 / 242"/></picture></span></span>

<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="database-management"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#database-management" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Database management</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">If you are using any database-backed persistence implementation (such as Postgres or Redis) to store short and/or long-term memory, you will need to run migrations to set up the required schema before you can use it with your database.</span>
<span data-as="p">By convention, most database-specific libraries define a <code>setup()</code> method on the checkpointer or store instance that runs the required migrations. However, you should check with your specific implementation of <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/checkpoints/#langgraph.checkpoint.base.BaseCheckpointSaver" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>BaseCheckpointSaver</code></a> or <a href="https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/store/#langgraph.store.base.BaseStore" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link"><code>BaseStore</code></a> to confirm the exact method name and usage.</span>
<span data-as="p">We recommend running migrations as a dedicated deployment step, or you can ensure they’re run as part of server startup.</span>
